items.overview: Exploring the company founding and the implosion of the business by outside investors who took over the company, left it bankrupt and under investigation.

overviews.es: El documental de HBO cuenta la historia del origen, el ascenso meteórico y la implosión más extraña atraves de una aplicación de suscripción de películas cinematográficas, MoviePass. Solo para finalmente verse marginados, por cómo los nuevos ejecutivos tomaban el control y se producía el caos.
overviews.bg: Шеметна възход и небивалия край на MoviePass - вече печално известната абонаментна услуга за кино.
overviews.fr: Exploration de la création de l'entreprise éponyme et de son implosion par des investisseurs extérieurs qui ont pris le contrôle de la société.
overviews.de: Erforscht die Unternehmensgründung und die Implosion des Unternehmens durch externe Investoren, die das Unternehmen übernahmen, es in Konkurs gehen ließen und gegen die ermittelt wird.
overviews.pt: Através dos olhos de seus fundadores, este documentário retrata a história do fenômeno da cultura pop MoviePass, o aplicativo de assinatura de ingressos para o cinema, desde sua origem e ascensão meteórica até sua implosão inesperada.

items.title: Pea Soup
items.overview: Images and sounds are spliced together in this journey to the heart of the political, economic and cultural oppression of the Quebec people. A reflection on neo-colonial exploitation and the cancer of alienation. To the very Canadian multiculturalism of Trudeau and the métissage of the multinationals, celebrated by the high priests of the dominant ideology, is contrasted the idea of acculturation, even deculturation. A way of resisting as good as any other.

overviews.fr: En une centaine de tableaux, Pea Soup dépeint l'écart entre les riches et les pauvres, les patrons et les employés, mais aussi les différences culturelles entre les classes sociales. Opposant à leurs tournages des extraits d'autres films, Pierre Falardeau et Julien Poulin ont réalisé un collage qui constitue une cinglante critique de la soumission du peuple québécois.

items.title: The Platypus Guardian
items.overview: Pete Walsh is a Tasmanian obsessed with one of nature’s least understood creatures, the platypus: an egg-laying, duck-billed, venom-spined, furry-coated underwater mammal. The natural environment of the platypus is in danger from urban development in the capital city of Hobart. With the help of experts, Pete embarks on a mission to rally his community and save the species before it is too late.

overviews.de: In der tasmanischen Hauptstadt Hobart schließt Peter Walsh eine ungewöhnliche Freundschaft zu einem Schnabeltier. Der 50-Jährige hat gerade erfahren, dass er an einer schlimmen Erkrankung leidet; deshalb verbringt er seine Freizeit damit, Fotos in freier Natur zu machen, um sich zu entspannen. Während der Corona-Pandemie verschreibt er sich ganz dem Schutz dieser gefährdeten Tiere. (Text: arte)

items.title: The Last Scene
items.overview: The story of an indigenous Ese’eja child facing the death of his grandfather. During the two days that separate the two traditional funerals the child decides to go for the first time to the city, to chase his grandfather dream and set his spirit free.

overviews.ru: История мальчика из редкой народности эсе-эхха, столкнувшегося со смертью своего деда. В один из дней, разделяющих два вида традиционных похорон, ребенок решает впервые пойти в город, чтобы осуществить дедушкину мечту и освободить свой дух.

items.title: Death in Amara
items.overview: San Sebastian, Basque Country, Spain, June 27, 1960. A bomb explodes at the Amara train station. Begoña, a child of only twenty months, dies a few hours later as a result of the injuries sustained in the attack.

overviews.es: San Sebastián, País Vasco, España, 27 de junio de 1960. Una bomba explota en la estación de tren de Amara. Begoña, una niña de solo veinte meses, muere pocas horas después a consecuencia de las heridas sufridas en el atentado.

items.title: Lakeside Suite
items.overview: Shot entirely from a boat on a lake, this evocative film confronts the viewer resolutely with his or her sensitivity for the moment. Surrounded by sounds of animal life, both from the lake and the neighbouring forests, this film takes us through the seasons. Sounds of water, the wind and a human presence.

overviews.pt: Repleto de sons de animais do lago e das florestas vizinhas, o espectador viaja pelas estações do ano com este filme. Sons de água, vento e presença humana.

items.title: 1000 Men and Me: The Bonnie Blue Story
items.overview: Adult content creator Bonnie Blue announced that she’d slept with 1057 men in 12 hours. Exploring the polarising debate around Bonnie and the pornification of our society, the film follows her over the most eye-opening six months of her life.

items.title: Document 72 Hours
items.overview: An unusual documentary series that delves into human dramas through chance encounters with ordinary people at selected spots. Filmed over 72 hours in a single location, the show captures glimpses into people's lives as they open up and share their stories.

overviews.ja: 人々が行き交う街角で、3日間。同じ時代にたまたま居あわせた私たち。みんな、どんな事情を抱え、どこへ行く？
overviews.de: Drei Tage im Leben von... Bleiben Sie 72 Stunden lang an einem Ort und werfen Sie einen Blick in das Leben der Menschen, während sie sich öffnen und es mit Ihnen teilen.

items.title: ANIME MANGA EXPLOSION
items.overview: The size of the Japanese animation market was 2,426 billion yen by 2020. More than half of that amount came from overseas sales. The manga market is also expanding, reaching 675.9 billion yen in 2021. Those unique visuals and stories from Japan have struck a chord with fans around the world and are growing into a huge industry. ANIME MANGA EXPLOSION will actively feature major works that are highly recognized by overseas fans and reveal the secrets of Japanese anime and manga creation through the series.

overviews.de: Die Größe des japanischen Animationsmarktes betrug im Jahr 2020 2.426 Milliarden Yen. Mehr als die Hälfte dieses Betrags stammte aus Verkäufen im Ausland. Auch der Manga-Markt wächst und erreicht im Jahr 2021 ein Volumen von 675,9 Milliarden Yen. Diese einzigartigen Bilder und Geschichten aus Japan haben bei Fans auf der ganzen Welt großen Anklang gefunden und entwickeln sich zu einer riesigen Branche. ANIME MANGA EXPLOSION wird aktiv bedeutende Werke präsentieren, die bei ausländischen Fans große Anerkennung finden, und durch die Serie die Geheimnisse der japanischen Anime- und Manga-Erstellung enthüllen.

items.title: Bares für Rares
items.overview: In the show, selected applicants each present a curiosity, rarity or antique they have brought with them. Once they have received their expertise, they will have the opportunity on site to offer their exhibit to a changing five-person podium for sale and, ideally, to sell it to the highest bidder for „Bares“ ("cash").

overviews.de: «Deutschlands größte Trödel Show». In der Sendung stellen ausgewählte Bewerber jeweils eine mitgebrachte Kuriosität, Rarität oder Antiquität vor. Nach erhaltener Expertise bekommen sie vor Ort Gelegenheit, ihr Exponat einem wechselnden fünfköpfigen Händlerpodium zum Kauf anzubieten und im besten Fall an den Höchstbietenden gegen „Bares“ zu veräußern.
overviews.fr: Cette émission allemande est l’équivalent de "Affaire conclue" en France. Des objets sont présentés et commentés par un expert, qui vérifie aussi leur authenticité, les répliques et les espèces animales et végétales protégées étant interdits à la vente dans l'émission. Dans le même temps, le présentateur de l'émission s'entretient avec le vendeur au sujet de l'histoire particulière de l'objet et du prix attendu. Si le prix de vente proposé par le vendeur est en adéquation avec l'expertise, le vendeur reçoit une carte de marchand (Händlerkarte) qui lui permet de proposer son objet à la vente dans la salle des marchands (Händlerraum). En revanche, si le vendeur s'obstine à proposer un prix trop haut, il ne reçoit pas de carte de marchand.
overviews.es: Invitados especiales traen consigo objetos antiguos y raros para que sean subastados.

items.title: Fantástico
items.overview: 'Fantástico' is a journalistic program shown on Sundays, presented by Poliana Abritta and Maju Coutinho. Every week, he presents special reports, shows and various paintings.

overviews.pt: Programa em forma de revista eletrônica, o Show da Vida mistura jornalismo, denúncia, esporte, humor, dramaturgia, documentário, música e ciência.

overviews.de: DOK ist eine Dokumentationssendung von Schweizer Radio und Fernsehen (SRF), die einst jeden Mittwoch und Donnerstag auf SRF 1 zu sehen war, unterdessen aber unregelmässig ausgestrahlt wird. Das Format besteht seit August 1990. Ausgestrahlt werden sowohl Eigenproduktionen wie auch ausgewählte internationale Dokumentarfilme.

items.title: Mayday
items.overview: Major real-life air disasters are depicted in this series. Each episode features a detailed dramatized reconstruction of the incident based on cockpit voice recorders and air traffic control transcripts, as well as eyewitnesses recounts and interviews with aviation experts.

overviews.de: Mayday stellt in jeder Folge den Flug nach, wobei die Folgen jeweils am Flughafen beginnen. Die Innenaufnahmen werden mit Schauspielern gedreht, die Außenansichten sind Animationen. Der ganze Flug wird mit Unglück und Folgen realitätsnah dargestellt. Wenn möglich, werden auch Interviews mit Augenzeugen oder Passagieren in die Handlung eingebettet. Nachdem der Flug und das Unglück dargestellt wurden, werden die Untersuchungen nachgestellt. Am Ende wird ein kurzes Fazit gezogen.
overviews.es: Cada episodio se centra en un desastre aéreo, primero dando al público la sensación de estar en el avión y luego explicando por qué se produjo el accidente. La serie brinda a los tele-espectadores tanto la sensación visceral del desastre como la explicación racional de lo que sucedió y qué derivó la industria de la aviación como aprendizaje a raíz del accidente.
overviews.tr: Sürükleyici bir belgesel dizisi olan Air Crash Investigation, yakın zamanda yaşanan büyük uçak ve helikopter kazalarını araştırarak nasıl ve neden olduklarını ortaya çıkarmaya çalışıyor. Mayday, izleyicileri sıkıntı yaşayan altı farklı uçağın içine götürerek kokpitteki ve kabindeki gerginliği ve baskıyı yeniden hissettiriyor. Ustalıkla hazırlanmış bu dramatik yeniden canlandırmalar, kurtarılan kokpit ses kayıtlarının ve hayatta kalanların ifadelerinin deşifrelerine dayanıyor. Haber görüntüleri, görgü tanıklarıyla yapılan röportajlar ve uçuşla ilgili bilgisayar grafikleri, havacılık sektöründeki tartışmaların merkezinde yer alan güvenlik konularına ışık tutuyor.
overviews.ru: Реконструкция реальных воздушных катастроф, интервью с авиационным специалистами и очевидцами происшествий.
overviews.ar: برنامج تلفزيوني وثائقي من إنتاج Cineflix في كندا. وتم بثها على قناة ديسكفري وكندا، ومجلة ناشيونال جيوجرافيك. ويحقق هذا الفيلم الوثائقي في العديد من حوادث تحطم الطائرات في التاريخ الحديث بعد فحص الصندوق الأسود والاستماع لتسجيل الصندوقين الأسودين للطائرة. انه يكشف عن الأحداث التي أدت إلى كل من الكوارث، وأسباب الحوادث والتدابير الموصى بها في تقرير الهيئة القومية لسلامة الطيران، أو لمنع حدوث حادث مماثل مرة أخرى. انه ملامح لإعادة التشريعات، والمقابلات، والشهادات، وتوليد الصور الكمبيوتر، وبعض الحلقات، وقمرة القيادة وتسجيلات صوتية لإعادة تسلسل الأحداث إلى الجمهور.
overviews.pt: É uma série real e cativante que investiga catástrofes aéreas recentes para descobrir como e por que elas aconteceram. Filmagens, entrevistas com testemunhas-chave e computação gráfica dos aviões durante o voo ajudam a explicar as controvérsias que existem no coração da indústria aérea.
overviews.fr: Cette série revient sur les grandes catastrophes aériennes. Ces films, mélange de reconstitutions et de témoignages, nous plongent dans une atmosphère angoissante et un suspense haletant. Interventions des survivants et des parents de victimes, explications d’experts, étude de la boîte noire de l'avion, rapports des autorités… Un important travail d'enquête a été mené afin de tenter de comprendre les raisons de ces crashes.
overviews.bg: Поредицата разказва удивителните истории на оцелели при някои от най-трагичните инциденти в историята на авиацията. Новинарски репортажи, интервюта, възстановки, анализ на експерти, компютърна графика - 8-мият сезон на документалната поредица за легендарните следователи използва най- разнообразни средства, за да изясни мистериозните авиационни бедствия. Разследванията са не само уникален телевизионен продукт, но и час т от усилията за повишаване безопасността на полетите. Всеки път, когато се разбива самолет, светът анализира ситуацията.
overviews.sv: I haverikommissionen undersöker vi några av historiens mest chockerande och uppmärksammade flygplansolyckor. Genom att använda arkivmaterial, rekonstruktioner och dataanimeringar samt vittnesmål från överlevare och räddningspersonal visar vi hur varje krasch och utredning har förbättrat flygsäkerheten genom åren. Varje avsnitt av Haverikommissionen återskapar varje olycka i minsta detalj och går sen igenom händelseförloppet för att fastställa orsaken bakom olyckan. Många av utredningarna har lett till att flygplansindustrin har förändrat rutinerna, något som inger hopp om att även de mest fruktansvärda olyckorna kan leda till revolutionerande förändringar som markant förbättrar flygsäkerheten.
overviews.ja: 『メーデー！』シリーズでは、過去に実際起きた悲劇的な飛行機事故を、丁寧に検証していく。事故を引き起こす原因となった証拠を探り、生存者や被害者の家族のコメント、運輸安全委員会の調査結果、ブラックボックスが語る全記録等から得た手がかりを繋ぎ合わせ再現VTRや実際の映像を織り交ぜながら事故の全貌を解明するドキュメンタリー。
overviews.it: Indagini ad alta quota (Mayday in lingua originale, conosciuto anche come Air Emergency o Air Crash Investigation) è un programma televisivo documentaristico canadese prodotto dalla Cineflix. Il programma analizza incidenti, mancati incidenti (near miss), dirottamenti e attentati aerei realmente accaduti per mezzo di ricostruzioni sceneggiate e immagini generate al computer e basandosi su rapporti ufficiali e testimonianze oculari. In ogni episodio esperti di aviazione, piloti, testimoni e investigatori sono intervistati sulle cause dell'incidente analizzato e sulle modalità di investigazione. Ripercorrendo la sequenza di eventi a partire dalle prove disponibili, ciascun documentario si propone di ricostruire con precisione la dinamica degli eventi e al contempo di illustrare le raccomandazioni e le prescrizioni introdotte a seguito degli incidenti stessi, per evitare il ripetersene.
overviews.pl: Kulisy dochodzenia w sprawie najbardziej zagadkowych katastrof, jakie zdarzyły się w historii lotnictwa.
overviews.ko: 세계 각지에서 일어난 항공 사고를 검증하는 프로그램이다.  조종석 음성 기록 장치(CVR)와 비행 데이터 레코더(FDR), 목격자/사고기 탑승객/수사관의 인터뷰와 실제 교신 기록을 바탕으로 재현된 CG영상, 그리고 그 외의 다양한 영상 자료로 구성되어 있다.
overviews.id:
Mengungkap kenyataan gelap bahwa keamanan penerbangan membaik kecelakaan demi kecelakaan, Mayday menyelidiki malapetaka penerbangan legendaris untuk mencari tahu apa yang salah dan alasannya.

Berdasarkan perekam suara kokpit, laporan kecelakaan dan saksi mata, setiap episode juga menampilkan wawancara, CGI canggih dan peragaan yang mencekam.

items.title: Profissão Repórter
items.overview: Caco Barcellos and a team of young journalists go to the streets, together, to present different angles of the same fact, from the same news. Each reporter always has a mission to fulfill, which involves tasks both in the performance of the live report and in its completion.

overviews.pt:
Profissão: Repórter é um programa jornalístico semanal brasileiro, produzido e exibido pela Rede Globo, que vai ao ar nas noites de terça-feira. Originalmente foi criado como um quadro do programa Fantástico, tornando-se um programa fixo na emissora em 2008.

O programa é reprisado pelo canal a cabo Globo News aos sábados e domingos.

items.title: Vetenskapens värld
items.overview: Vetenskapens värld is a popular science TV documentary program broadcast on Swedish Television (SVT).

overviews.sv: Vetenskapens värld är ett populärvetenskapligt TV-dokumentärprogram som sänds i Sveriges Television. Programledare 1971-2003 var Bo G. Erikson. Från och med den 13 januari 2003 var Henrik Ekman programledare. Nuvarande programledare är Victoria Dyring som tog över 2010 efter Mia-Marie Lundén. Programmet vill "visa det bästa som produceras i den internationella TV-världen, inom vetenskapens område". Programmets redaktion samarbetar med flera av världens främsta TV-bolag, främst i USA och England.

items.title: Panorama
items.overview: Current affairs programme, featuring interviews and investigative reports on a wide variety of subjects.

overviews.pt: Programa de atualidades, com entrevistas e reportagens investigativas sobre uma ampla variedade de assuntos.
overviews.it: Una serie di reportage prodotti dalla BBC sui principali temi di attualità in Inghilterra e nel mondo.
overviews.es: Investigación periodística de actualidad nacional e internacional destacada.
overviews.fr: Panorama est une émission de télévision d'actualité britannique, lancée le 11 novembre 1953 et produite par la BBC. C'est une émission d'investigation journalistique. Richard Dimbleby en était le présentateur original, durant les années 1950 et les années 1960. Son fils, David Dimbleby, a continué à présenter l'émission les années suivantes. Panorama est diffusée sur la chaîne publique BBC One, à 20h30 chaque lundi.

seasonList.overview:
Panorama began broadcasting on 11th November 1953 as a fortnightly show. Described by the Radio Times of the day as a “reflection of the contemporary scene” it included reviews of the contemporary arts as well as featuring documentary pieces.

The first season of Panorama concluded its run on 4th Au

The second season of Panorama began on the 20th of October. Similar to the first year, it was described as “a fortnightly topical magazine” by the Radio Times of the day. Again introduced by Max Robertson the series ran from the end of 1954 until the middle of 1955, ending on the 10th of August.

items.title: RE: European Stories
items.overview: Discover Europe in all its diversity of viewpoints

overviews.fr: L’Europe dans sa diversité en reportages quotidiens : une plongée dans des réalités inédites.
overviews.de: Nah dran, authentisch, echt - der Mensch im Mittelpunkt. In 30 Minuten taucht Re: in Lebenswelten ein und macht Europas Vielfalt erlebbar.
overviews.es: Reportajes sobre la diversidad de Europa encarnada en la vida de sus ciudadanos.

items.title: Galileo
items.overview: This daily German magazine show delivers interesting facts on numerous topics centering around technology, life, and bizarre knowledge.

overviews.de: Eine volle Stunde Galileo, das heißt eine volle Stunde Interessantes und Wissenswertes in gewohnter Premium-Qualität - und mit einer Themenvielfalt, die ihresgleichen sucht. Täglich überrascht Galileo die Zuschauer mit faszinierenden Bildern zu zahlreichen neuen Rubriken rund um Technik, Leben und skurriles Wissen - wie immer verblüffend einfach und für jeden verständlich erklärt.
overviews.pl: Galileo – polski telewizyjny program popularnonaukowy oparty na niemieckim formacie o tej samej nazwie emitowany od 2007 roku na antenie TV4. Jego prowadzącym jest Paweł Orleański.

items.title: Fuse
items.overview: Fitil is a popular Soviet/Russian television satirical/comedy short film series which ran for about 500 episodes. Some of the episodes were aimed at children, and were called Фитилёк, Fitilyok, Little Fuse. Each issue contained from the few short segments: documentary, fictional and animated ones. Directed by various artists, including Leonid Gaidai who presented his famous trio of Nikulin, Vitsin and Morgunov into the cast. It was called in USSR as "the anecdotes from the Soviet government".

overviews.ru: Всесоюзный сатирический киножурнал «Фитиль», затем - телевизионный сатирический журнал «Фитиль» - сатирико-юмористическая критическая программа с элементами журналистского расследования. Выпуски журнала состояли из разных сюжетов: игровых, документальных (героев переозвучивали), мультипликационных.

items.title: NOVA
items.overview: PBS' premier science series helps viewers of all ages explore the science behind the headlines. Along the way, NOVA demystifies science and technology, and highlights the people involved in scientific pursuits.

overviews.ru: Телесериал «Nova» рассказывает о научных открытиях и исторических событиях. Включает в себя интервью с учёными — математиками, физиками, астрономами, историками, археологами.
overviews.es: Serie documental semanal; cada episodio proporciona una mirada en profundidad sobre diferentes temas de investigación científica; examinando por ejemplo, desde los efectos a largo plazo de la deforestación de la selva amazónica, hasta un retorno a la central nuclear de Chernobyl, o información sobre los últimos avances en las técnicas médicas o la física teórica.
overviews.bg: Първият научен сериал на PBS помага на зрителите от всички възрасти да изследват науката зад заглавията. По време на път NOVA демистифицира науката и технологиите и подчертава хората, които участват в научните занимания.
overviews.de: Die führende Wissenschaftssendung von PBS ermöglicht Zuschauern jeden Alters, die wissenschaftlichen Hintergründe aktueller Schlagzeilen zu erkunden.
overviews.ar: سلسلة نوفا العلمية الرائدة على پي بي اس تساعد المشاهدين من جميع الأعمار على استكشاف العلم وراء العناوين الرئيسية. وعلى طول الطريق، تقوم نوڤا بفك رموز العلم والتكنولوجيا، وتسلط الضوء على الأشخاص المشاركين في المساعي العلمية.

items.title: Cuisines des terroirs
items.overview: A sensual approach to culinary art "on the ground", meeting farmers, winegrowers, restaurateurs and cooks, where gastronomy and the art of living have their roots.

overviews.de: "Zu Tisch" besucht unsere europäischen Nachbarn und schaut in die Töpfe. Dabei werden regionale kulinarische Schätze aufgespürt - frisch vom Hof auf den Tisch.
overviews.fr: Une approche sensuelle de l’art culinaire « sur le terrain », à la rencontre des paysans, vignerons, restaurateurs et cuisiniers, là où gastronomie et art de vivre ont leurs racines.

X:enius est une émission de vulgarisation scientifique diffusée sur Arte. Sous forme d'un magazine de 26 minutes, X:enius répond de manière scientifique et accessible à des thèmes très variés qui sont souvent l'occasion de voyager à travers l'Europe et le monde.

items.title: Découverte
items.overview: Charles Tisseyre explores the world of science and technology through real-world stories. Each episode features reports delving into technological breakthroughs and developments in scientific research, environmental issues, space exploration, as well as health and medicine.

overviews.fr: Découverte est une émission de télévision de vulgarisation scientifique québécoise animée par Charles Tisseyre et diffusée sur ICI Radio-Canada Télé depuis 1988.

items.title: Tamasha
items.overview: Tamasha is Pakistan's boldest celebrity reality show, where drama, strategy, and raw emotions collide inside a sealed house. A group of diverse celebrities from across the entertainment world live together for weeks-completely cut off from the outside world. Under constant surveillance, they face daily challenges, personal conflicts, and power struggles. As alliances shift and secrets unravel, only one housemate can survive the drama to claim the ultimate title. In this house, every move is a performance-and every moment is Tamasha.

seasonList.overview: Contestants from various walks of life are locked in a specially designed house, cut off from the outside world. Over several weeks, they live together, perform tasks, face nominations, and experience evictions until one contestant emerges as the winner with the largest cash prize yet.

items.title: Aik Mohabbat Aur
items.overview: ACP Khushbakht, a strong yet emotionally guarded officer, returns to her parents’ home after a failed marriage, losing faith in love while raising her young son. When a case brings her together with Haroon, an idealistic journalist searching for genuine connection, he finds himself drawn to her resilience and hidden pain. As Haroon falls in love, Khushbakht struggles to let go of her past, setting the stage for a journey of healing, trust, and the possibility of a second chance at love.

items.title: Noor Jahan
items.overview: A matriarch's domineering presence tests the bond of her upper-class family as she assertively shapes her three sons' destinies amidst unexpected challenges.

items.overview: Each episode features a Pakistani celebrity interviewed by Peerzada about their journeys, struggles, challenges and success.

items.overview: Set inside an old, imposing house owned by Jahan Ara, the story unfolds as different tenants enter her world each burdened with personal trauma, marital conflicts, and unspoken desires. What appears to be a calm domestic setting slowly transforms into a psychological battlefield, where kindness carries hidden motives and relationships begin to fracture under silent pressure.

items.overview: A story about trust, love, and misunderstandings, how a woman needs trust and respect more than love. the plot revolves around how difficult grief and loss situations can change relationships - sometimes making them stronger, and sometimes testing them beyond what they can handle.

items.overview: The series revolves around two people who hate each other but their families want them to marry. They make some plans to cancel their wedding but slowly get in love.

The series explores the story of Jiya and Arsal after their marriage and also focuses on the marriage ceremonies of Sherry with Kinza and Billo with Joji. They had realised their love for each other during the last season.

items.title: Zanjeerain
items.overview: Love, greed, loyalty, and traditions clash in a picturesque mountain village. Rabiya, a resilient roadside bakery owner, gradually becomes entangled in a web of conspiracy in the local clan.

overviews.ar: تدور أحداث مسلسل "سلسلة" في أحضان الجبال الخضراء الخلابة، وهو قصة مؤثرة عن الحب والطمع والأسرار التي نخفيها. في هذا العالم، لكل شخص سرٌّ يخفيه؛ فمنهم من يلتزم بقواعد قديمة، ومنهم من يتوق إلى السلطة، ومنهم من يحاول حماية من يحب. إنها دراما ملحمية مثيرة، حيث لكل خيار أهميته، وكل شخصية تكافح لإيجاد طريقها. ادخل عالم "سلسلة"، رحلة فريدة ومؤثرة تُختبر فيها القلوب والإمبراطوريات.

seasonList.name: Season 1
seasonList.overview: Set in the beautiful, green mountains, Zanjeerain is a powerful story about love, greed, and the secrets we keep. In this world, everyone has something to hide—some are stuck following old rules, others are hungry for power, and some are just trying to protect the people they love. It is a big, exci

items.title: KHAN
items.overview: Khan is the story of a homicidal kingmaker, who has strong influences in making and demolishing government. He lives with his family members in a gigantic villa apparently as a social worker, loving father and a noble person of society. Khan is out and out a family man, who cares about every relation in his surroundings. He pampers his wife, gives unconditional love to his daughter, and being the caretaker of his sister speaks volume about his gentleman hood. Not only this, he always remember his ex-lover in a sincere manner but very few of people know the other side of khan’s dark personality.

items.title: Meri Zindagi Hai Tu
items.overview: Kamyar, a charming yet impulsive man, and Ayra, a principled girl with a pure heart. What begins as a sweet connection turns into a storm of emotions, deception, and longing, testing the strength of love and trust.

overviews.ar: قصة حب مؤثرة بين شاب مندفع وفتاة ذات مبادئ وقلب نقي. فما يبدأ كعلاقة لطيفة يتحول إلى عاصفة من المشاعر والخداع والشوق تختبر قوة الحب والثقة.

seasonList.name: Season 1
seasonList.overview: The season follows Ayra, Kamyar, Falak, and their families as love, betrayal, and redemption intertwine. Each episode builds on emotional conflicts, family pressures, and the struggle between tradition and personal choice.

items.title: Winter Love
items.overview: A modern romance set in a "season of silence" where two souls who are worlds apart find warmth in each other.

items.title: Lifafa Dayaan
items.overview: The story will unveil some dark secrets of journalism which involve dirty politics, bribery, lies, and revenge. The series will surely gonna make you addict to it.

items.title: Pamaal (Ruined / Destroyed)
items.overview: Malika defies all odds for love, walking away from comfort, tradition and the safety of the family. But what she found wasn’t the fairytale she imagined. With Raza, stability turns into restraint as her spirit begins to fade. Pamaal is a story of love, loss, and rediscovery, where the end of one journey becomes the beginning of another.

items.title: Meray Humsafar
items.overview: Hala, an innocent and timid girl, gets married to Hamza. However, her mother-in-law treats her badly while Hamza tries his best to take a stand for his wife.

overviews.ar: مسلسل تلفزيوني يروي قصة حياة هالة المولودة لأب باكستاني وأم أجنبية تتركهما بعد ولادتها.

items.title: Sur Kshetra
items.overview:
Sur Kshetra is a singing talent show or musical battle between teams of two neighboring countries: Pakistan and India aired simulcast on Geo TV, Sahara One, Colors TV, AAG TV as well as Rishtey. The show is hosted by Indian actress Ayesha Takia. The Pakistani Team is led by singer, music director, music composer, actor Atif Aslam and the Indian Team is led by music director Himesh Reshamiya.

It is being shown on Colors TV and Sahara One in India, Geo TV and Aag TV in Pakistan and Rishtey TV in UK.

The show hasbeen produced by Saaibaba Telefilms and Directed by Gajendrra Siingh under the creative production of Santosh Shendye. The creative Director of the show is Kshonish Palit and Associate Creative Director is Mohammad Faizan.

items.title: Leader
items.overview: Mansoor, a farmer’s son with a vision to build a just society free from feudal oppression. As he rises within the political landscape of his university, his beliefs are challenged when he falls in love with Rubab, daughter of the very man he stands against. Torn between love and ambition, Mansoor must decide how far he is willing to go for his ideals. Will love weaken his resolve... or redefine his purpose?

items.title: Aansoo
items.overview: It is a story of two families as they recover from tragedies that have torn them apart. Two best friends realize that they are in fact brothers living each other's lives. On the other hand, cultural differences leave two sisters living on opposite sides of the world with no knowledge of each other's existence.

items.title: Mohra
items.overview: After a tragedy strikes her family, Alizay seeks revenge against the wealthy Hamdani family, whose pride and greed have caused irreparable damage to her modest but once-happy life with her mother and sister.

items.title: Bandish
items.overview: The story shows the suffering of a family that is under the influence of Black Magic. Madiha, has a loving husband and three beautiful daughters. Her life is perfect until a woman starts performing black magic on her family.

items.title: Tanaa Banaa
items.overview: Tanaa Banaa is focused on two teenagers stuck in a marriage arrangement. Starring Alizeh Shah, Daniyal. The drama perfectly encapsulates the true essence of youth in a very lighthearted way.

items.title: Aap Ki Adalat
items.overview: The host invites various personalities who must defend themselves in light of their recent controversies and against the accusations levied on them by the public.

items.title: Idiot
items.overview: Idiot is an ode to all the social misfits and rebels who question dysfunctional man-made norms of society, all the wanderers embarked on the journey of self-discovery and searching for the greater purpose of existence.

items.title: Standup Girl
items.overview: Embark on a thrilling odyssey as a young woman navigates an identity crisis, shattering stereotypes on her path to fulfilling her dream of becoming a stand-up comedian.

seasonList.name: Season 1
seasonList.overview: Embark on Zara’s journey as she navigates the aftermath of a profound loss, grapples with identity crisis and explores the intricacies of joining her ‘BHAAND’ family in Androon Lahore.

items.title: Meem Se Mohabbat
items.overview: ‘Meem Se Muhabbat’ revolves around a moving tale that artfully intertwines coincidence and destiny, bringing together two souls who could not be more dissimilar in their essence. In a world brimming with uncertainties, love manifests in the most unforeseen moments, defying the boundaries of logic, past and circumstance.

items.title: Dastak
items.overview: A divorced mother strives to create a better life for her son while navigating societal pressures and asserting her independence.

items.title: Bay Dardi
items.overview: The story of Shafay, a HIV-positive man who doesn't know how he contracted the virus.

overviews.ar: قصة شافعي رجل مصاب بفيروس نقص المناعة المكتسبة لا يعرف كيف أصيب بالفيروس.

items.title: Mere Meherban
items.overview: A story of two women Shaista and Nayyara, and their daughters. Shaista is very selfish and has spoiled her husband's life. Shaista's daughters, Muskan and Iraj are stylish, having a very rude and aggressive behaviour with everyone, especially their cousins. Nayyara is a cousin of Shaista and a wife of her brother-in-law. She is happy and middle-class. Meanwhile, Nayyara's daughters Fala, Fariya and Haya are simple, sweet in nature who give respect to everyone.

items.title: Ertugrul Ghazi Urdu
items.overview: The heroic story of Ertugrul Ghazi, the father of Osman (Uthman) who founded the Ottoman Empire.

overviews.ko:
오스만 제국의 창시자 오스만 1세의 아버지

Ertugrul Bey의 일대기를 그린 픽션 역사극

items.title: Do Kinaray
items.overview: They never spoke the same language of love. But the sea remembers. The waves will tell the story of pain, distance, and what lies between.

items.title: Dour
items.overview: Mrs. Ehtishaam has provided her sons with every luxury in the world. One of her sons, Abaan, is unable to live life to the fullest as he happens to be handicapped. However, her sons are unaware of a tragic secret she has been withholding from them, especially from Romaan who is always at his best behavior and is an asset to the family business. After years of causing distress to his family, Abaan finds a new target after Romaan introduces his family to the love of his life, Asma.

items.title: Kuruluş Osman
items.overview: The epic continuation of Diriliş Ertuğrul, Kuruluş Osman follows Osman Bey — son of Ertuğrul and destined founder of the Ottoman Empire — as he transforms a small Turkic tribe into a sovereign state. Battling the Byzantine Empire, Mongol forces and treachery from within, Osman must prove himself as both a warrior and a leader. A sweeping historical action drama built on faith, honour and the birth of one of history's greatest empires.

overviews.tr: Dizi, Ertuğrul Gazi'nin oğlu ve Osmanlı İmparatorluğu'nun kurucusu Osman Bey'in hayatına odaklanacak.
overviews.ar: حياة عثمان بك ابن ارطغرل غازي ومؤسس الدولة العثمانية.
overviews.ru: После смерти Эртугрула бразды правления турецкими землями перешли к его наследнику, 23-летнему Осману I Гази. Юноше досталась территория Фригии, однако это амбициозного вождя не устраивало: он мечтал, чтобы слава о могуществе родного государства гремела на весь мир. Несмотря на малый опыт, молодой правитель принялся успешно расширять границы своей страны: присоединил значительную часть Византии, обеспечив туркам выходы к Мраморному и Черному морям, объединился со сбежавшими от монголов мусульманами. Самым бесстрашным воином его армии был сам Осман: он всегда находился в гуще событий, подавая братьям по оружию достойный пример. Усилиями этого султана Турция станет великой империей, что будет носить его имя. Но это спустя годы, а пока впереди у него множество испытаний: предательство близких людей, новые завоевания и потери, козни завистников и главная любовь всей жизни.
overviews.pt: A vida de Osman Bey, filho de Ertugrul Gazi e fundador do Império Otomano.
overviews.es: Hace 15 años de la guerra liderada por Ertuğrul Gazi. Enfermo, viaja a Konya, dejando el mando a su hermano Dündar Bey. Dündar visita la fortaleza bizantina de Kulucahisar para renovar un pacto de paz y comercio. Osman, el hijo menor de Ertuğrul, lo acompaña y salva al gobernador Yorgopolos de un intento de asesinato. En la búsqueda de los culpables, muere su amigo Aybars, lo que lleva a Osman a jurar venganza. Su actitud valiente pero impulsiva causa tensiones con Dündar y su hermano Gündüz.
overviews.ko: 3세기 말 아시아와 유럽을 연결하는 땅, '아나톨리아' 그 땅에서 살던 유목부족을 통일하여 세 대륙에 걸친 대제국을 건설한 오스만. 오스만 제국의 창시자인 오스만 1세의 삶과 제국을 건설하는 과정을 그린 드라마

seasonList.name: Season 1
seasonList.overview: Osman, nephew of Dündar Bey, navigates a treacherous path as he confronts the machinations of Selçuk Sançak Bey Alişar and the ruthless Sofia of Kulucahisar, who plots against the Kayı tribe, while also battling external threats from the Mongols, culminating in the conquest of Kulucahisar and Osman'

seasonList.name: Season 2
seasonList.overview: Osman faces new challenges as he becomes the Sardar after his father's death, marries Malhun Hatun, and battles the Byzantines and Mongol Governor Geyhatu, ultimately leading to the Battle of Domaniç and the execution of his treacherous uncle Dündar.

seasonList.name: Season 3
seasonList.overview: Osman Bey faces challenges from the Byzantine Emperor, a Mongol Governor, and a treacherous uncle, while also navigating alliances, betrayals, and the death of his father, ultimately leading to the Battle of Domaniç and the death of Togay.

seasonList.name: Season 4
seasonList.overview: Osman faces Byzantine plots, including Kantakuzenos's assassination attempt and the framing of Öktem Bey and his daughter Alcicek, which Osman ultimately foils, while Alcicek and Aktemur fall in love.

seasonList.name: Season 5
seasonList.overview: Osman Bey continues his quest for Bursa, faces challenges from Yakup Bey who declares himself Sultan, and navigates conflicts with the Ilkhanate and Byzantine forces, including the kidnapping of princess Maria.

seasonList.name: Season 6
seasonList.overview: Sofia, who was thought dead, returns and joins forces with Commander Lucas, raising Halime, Osman and Bala's daughter, as her niece and training her against her parents, while the Kayi tribe faces threats from the Mongols and internal tensions.

items.title: Redemption
items.overview: Orhun is a successful businessman who was raised in a wealthy but loveless family along with his twin sister Nihan, younger sister Nurşah and their cold, distant mother Afife. Nihan left to do volunteer work as a doctor in Eritrea, but recently she has been impossible to contact, and her family is worried about her. While looking for his sister, he comes across Hira, a poor girl living the life of a prisoner at the hands of traffickers. When they find out that Nihan has been poisoned and killed by a local gang, Orhun breaks down. When it emerges that it was actually Hira who poisoned his sister, Orhun hatches an evil revenge plan. Meanwhile, Afife, their mother, has kept Orhun's father away since his childhood secretly. Orhun decides to marry Hira as revenge. Afife hates people of lower status and she’s obsessed with “pure blood”. Will this marriage imprison Afife , or will the couple find redemption after paying all their dues?

overviews.pt: Orhun, o herdeiro aparente da família Demirhanli, ocupará seu lugar na tela com o amor vingativo de Hira. Orhun, que puniu os perpetradores, será agora guiado pelo fogo da vingança em seu coração.
overviews.tr:
Bir yanda kibri ve intikam hırsıyla yanıp tutuşan Orhun, diğer yanda günahsız olduğu halde kendine biçilen rolü üstlenmeye hazır Hira… Demirhanlı ailesinin veliahdı Orhun ve ikiz kardeşini öldürdüğünü düşündüğü Hira’nın intikamla yoğurulan aşkı Esaret adıyla ekrana geliyor.

Demirhanlı Konağı acı bir haberle sarsılır. Ailenin lideri, kudretli Orhun Demirhanlı’nın ikiz kız kardeşi, görev için gittiği Afrika’da korkunç bir cinayete kurban gider. Kız kardeşini almak için gittiği Afrika’da acı gerçekle yüzleşen Orhun, kardeşinin katillerini cezalandırmayı kafasına koyar. Yüreğindeki intikam ateşiyle hayatına devam etmeye çalışan Orhun, Afrika’dan dönerken içinde kor bir ateş, yanında ise köle bir kız olan Hira vardır. Bundan sonra ne dünya eskisi gibi olacaktır ne de Orhun Demirhanlı…
overviews.ru:
Орхун молод, властен, тщеславен, влиятелен. Он был наследником семейства Демирханлы. Мужчина считал, что всего два типа людей на земле. У них по жилам течёт одинаковая красная кровь, только у одних — это кровь, а у других подделка дешевая. Одни приказы отдают, а другие исполняют их. Поэтому одни живут в нищете, а другие ни в чем не нуждаются.

Однажды страшной новостью был потрясён особняк Орхуна. Сестра-близнец главного героя, находясь в командировке, погибла в Африке. Орхун был в не себя от горя и ярости, поэтому намерен отомстить виновным в смерти сестры…

seasonList.name: Season 2
seasonList.overview: A year has passed since Hira's death. Orhun, who says goodbye to the corpse of the woman he loves, is in a mess. As he drowns in the deep sorrow of mourning, those around him disappear with him. Most of all, little Ali is attached to Hira like his mother! While everything is slipping out of Orhun's

items.title: Hayat Türküsü
items.overview: The educational struggle of Hayat, an idealist teacher, in a forgotten, backward village of Van among the mountains.

overviews.tr: Hayat Van'da seve seve göreve başlamış bir yeni öğretmendir. Hayat kararlıdır ve küçük bir köyde göreve başlar. Merkeze uzak bu köy, bugüne dek öyle çok öğretmen görmemiştir. Gelen öğretmenler de kısa bir süre kalmış, başka yerlere tayin aldırmışlardır. Bu yüzden köy çocukları okul için uzak köylerden birine yürüyerek gitmektedir. Hayat gelir gelmez camları, kapısı kırık dökük, sınıfları bakımsız bu köy okuluna yüreğinin sihrini taşıyan bir değnekle dokunacak ve yavaş yavaş değişim başlayacaktır. Minik öğrencileri de Hayat öğretmenlerinin emeğini, sevgisini boşa çıkarmayacak, Hayat onlara ışık tuttukça onlar da kitaplarına defterlerine dört elle sarılacaktır. Bu köyde yaşadıklarıyla annesinin çocukluğundan beri anlattığı köy hikayeleri daha bir anlam kazanacak, ete kemiğe bürünecektir.

items.title: Back Streets
items.overview: The series tells the story of the family lives of the police officers working in a special team of the Istanbul Police Department's Public Security Department and their adventures on the streets of Istanbul. The team encounters different and diverse human stories during their missions. The Istanbul Police Chief Rıza Soylu (Zafer Ergin), with his years of experience and fatherhood, approaches these stories, which at times make them smile and at other times are heartbreaking, and guides the other young members of the team.

overviews.bg: Сериалът разказва за истинското лице на един град в тъмните му улици. Ежедневието е изпълнено с тревоги и напрежение. В миг гневът се превръща в престъпление, а клеветите развалят приятелства. Един полицейски екип трябва да въдвори ред по тези тайнствени улици и се отдава на своята мисия безапелационно и с цялото си сърце. И без да пренебрегват служебните си задължения, героите преживяват същите драми и вълнения, като всеки един от нас.
overviews.tr: İstanbul Emniyet Müdürlüğü Asayiş Şube Müdürlüğü'nde özel bir ekipte görev yapan polislerin aile yaşamları ve İstanbul sokaklarındaki maceraları anlatılmaktadır. Ve bu şehrin her sokağını, herkes için daha güzel, daha yaşanır bir yer yapmak uğruna her türlü kötülüğe ve sıkıntıya meydan okuyan, sevinçte, kederde, aşkta ve yalnızlıkta her zaman birbirlerinin yanında olan bu yürekli polisler, “birliktelik ruhu” ve “mücadele azmiyle” minibüsleriyle bu metropolün sokaklarını arşınlamakta ve karşılarına çıkan her türlü kanunsuzlukla savaşarak suçluların korkulu rüyası olmaktadırlar. Ekip görevleri sırasında değişik ve çeşitli insan hikayeleriyle sürekli karşılaşmaktadır. Zaman zaman gülümseten, zaman zaman da iç burkan bu hikayelere, meslek yıllarının tecrübesi ve babalığıyla yaklaşan, ekibin diğer genç üyelerine de yol gösteren Emniyet amiri Rıza Baba olur.
overviews.ru: Сериал "Опасные улицы" о суровой и нелегкой жизни полицейских, которые готовы пожертвовать собой ради спокойствия граждан, также описывается жизнь уличных банд. Зритель сам решит кому симпатизировать в той или иной ситуации. Герои сериала временами заставляют плакать, временами смеяться над той ситуацией в которую попали.

items.title: Far Away
items.overview: Alya Albora arrives in Mardin with her late husband’s funeral and their five-year-old son to fulfill her husband’s last will. However, this arrival marks a point of no return, and there is no way out of Albora. The head of the Albora tribe, Cihan Albora, is not indifferent to Alya’s struggles, but he refuses to let her take her child and leave. Confronting the darkness of the past, hidden secrets, and the harsh realities of the region, Alya Albora finds herself caught in a fierce struggle with her late husband’s family.

overviews.ar: تصل امرأة إلى مسقط رأس زوجها الراحل برفقة جثمانه وابنهما، عازمة على دفنه بسلام. لكن سرعان ما تقيدها عائلته النافذة بشبكة من الأسرار والنفوذ، مما يجعل مغادرتها أمرا شبه مستحيل.
overviews.tr: Alya Albora, vefat eden eşinin vasiyetini yerine getirmek için cenazesi ve beş yaşındaki oğluyla Kanada’dan Mardin’deki Albora topraklarına gelir. Ancak bu gelişin bir dönüşü ve Albora’dan çıkışı yoktur. Albora aşiretinin başı Cihan Albora, Alya’nın çırpınışlarına kayıtsız kalmasa da çocuğunu alıp gitmesine izin vermez. Geçmişin karanlığı, saklanan sırlar ve bölgenin gerçeği ile yüzleşen Alya Albora, kendini kocasının ailesiyle büyük bir mücadele içinde bulur.
overviews.ru:
Алья, жена Борана Алборы и мать их сына Джихана Дениза, вынуждена вернуться из Канады в Мардин, чтобы исполнить последнюю волю покойного супруга, погибшего при загадочных обстоятельствах в аварии. С возвращением на родину Алья попадает в водоворот семейных интриг и напряжённой борьбы за наследие. Она сталкивается с братом Борана, Джиханом Алборой, и его семьёй, которые настроены отнять у неё сына и получить контроль над семейными владениями.

Для Альи это возвращение становится не только выполнением обещания, но и борьбой за своё будущее и безопасность сына. Ей предстоит противостоять обману, угрозам и скрытым тайнам, которые изменят её понимание семьи и любви.
overviews.it: Alya Albora arriva a Mardin dal Canada insieme alla salma del defunto marito e al loro figlio di cinque anni per adempiere alle ultime volontà dell'uomo: essere sepolto nella terra natia degli Albora. Tuttavia, questo arrivo segna un punto di non ritorno, non c'è via d'uscita da Albora. Sebbene Cihan Albora, il capo clan degli Albora, non sia indifferente alle difficoltà di Alya, non le permette di partire con il figlio. Affrontando le tenebre del passato, i segreti nascosti e la dura realtà della regione, Alya Albora si trova coinvolta in una feroce lotta con la famiglia del suo defunto marito.
overviews.es: Una doctora que vive en Canadá cuya vida da un giro inesperado tras la repentina muerte de su esposo. Cuando regresa con su pequeño hijo al pueblo natal de su marido, Mardin, Turquía, para lo que pensaba sería una breve despedida, se ve arrastrada a un mundo gobernado por poderosas tradiciones, secretos enterrados y despiadadas rivalidades familiares.
overviews.pt: Uma mulher chega à terra natal de seu falecido marido com seu corpo e filho, mas sua poderosa família a impede de sair, levando a uma batalha quando segredos obscuros vêm à tona.

seasonList.name: Season 1
seasonList.overview: A woman and her son arrive in her late husband's homeland with his corpse, determined to give him a proper burial. But his powerful family soon traps her in a web of secrets and control, making her escape impossible.

seasonList.name: Season 2
seasonList.overview: Cihan and Alya return to the mansion determined to protect their love despite all obstacles and the heavy price it may bring. Alya's refusal to go to Canada is seen by Sadakat as the beginning of disaster.

seasonList.name: Season 3
seasonList.overview: Cihan and Alya's reunion in Budapest takes an unexpected turn when Cihan insists on taking Deniz back to Mardin for his safety. As the only one who can carry on Ecmel's lineage, Deniz becomes the center of a new and dangerous family struggle, forcing Alya to fight to protect her son.

items.title: The Magnificent Century
items.overview: At the age of 26, when his reign began, Sultan Süleyman sought to build an empire more powerful than Alexander the Great and to render the Ottomans invincible. Throughout his 46-year reign, his fame as the greatest warrior and ruler of his age spreads both to the East and West.  With his companion Pargalı İbrahim, Süleyman achieves great victories, and makes his name known in the Muslim World. Süleyman called İbrahim his brother, friend and advisor. The television series shows Süleyman's consolidation of his power: Pargalı İbrahim being grand minister of state, reinforcing the rule of law throughout the empire, meeting foreign diplomats, and preparing for military campaigns, all set against the backdrop of the tension between Christian Europe and the Ottoman Empire.

overviews.tr: Osmanlı İmparatorluğu'nun XV. padişahı I. Süleyman, yirmi altı yaşında bu büyük iktidarı yönetmeye başladığında,  önüne öyle bir hedef koymuştu ki;  Büyük İskender’den daha güçlü ve yaygın bir dünyada egemenlik kuracak ve Osmanlı’yı yenilmez kılacaktı. Bu yürüyüş ona; batıdaki savaş zaferleri nedeniyle Muhteşem Süleyman, doğuda ise adaletli yönetimine atfen Kanunî Sultan Süleyman ismini kazandıracaktı.
overviews.es:
Historia del sultán otomano Solimán I, conocido  como Suleiman Kanuni ("el Legislador") y en occidente como Suleiman el  Magnífico, que gobernó desde 1520 hasta 1566. Durante su reinado, el  Imperio otomano se convirtió en una de las más grandes potencias y  alcanzó la cúspide de su poder.

Solimán lideró personalmente al ejército otomano cuando éste conquistaba  Belgrado, Rodas y la mayoría de Hungría, así como durante el sitio de  Viena y los territorios anexionados del Norte de África, Argelia, Túnez y  casi todo Oriente Medio. Solimán protegió y buscó el desarrollo de las  ciencias y las artes, acogiendo a numerosos filósofos, y él mismo fue  mencionado como uno de los más notables poetas musulmanes.
overviews.ru: Сюжет основан на реальных событиях, произошедших во времена правления султана Сулеймана I, и рассказывает о периоде жизни девушки Александры, взятой в плен турками и названной Хюррем. Позже она стала первой официальной женой Сулеймана, но для этого ей пришлось пройти сложный путь.
overviews.de: Muhteşem Yüzyıl (Das prächtige Jahrhundert) ist eine historische Fernsehserie über das Leben von Sultan Süleyman dem Prächtigen. Als sie im Januar 2011 in der Türkei erstausgestrahlt wurde, löste sie im Land eine hitzige Diskussion über ihre Darstellung von Vielweiberei und Sklaverei aus.
overviews.bg: Любовта между султана и украинската робиня Александра успява да измести вековните традиции в двореца и да отчужди владетеля от официалната му съпруга и семейството. Изкусителната украинка става причина за противоречия и в управлението на империята. Любовната история повдига завесата на изпълнения с тайни и интриги живот в султанския харем през най-величествения период на Османската империя. Дошла като безправна робиня от най-крайните земи на империята, Александра успява да спечели сърцето на султана. С блестящ ум, необикновена сила на волята и привлекателна външност, тя се превръща в жена на най-могъщия султан.
overviews.ko: 16세기의 오스만 제국을 배경으로 오스만 제국의 10대 술탄인 '술레이만 1세'와 전쟁 포로 출신의 노예에서 오스만 제국의 황후 '휘렘 술탄'이 된 '알렉산드라'의 일대기를 그린 터키 대하서사극
overviews.fr: Fiction historique basée sur la vie et la Cour du sultan ottoman Suleyman le Magnifique ainsi que son épouse Hurrem Sultan. Il est le sultan qui a régné le plus longtemps dans l'Empire ottoman.
overviews.ja: 1520年、セリム1世が逝去。皇太子であったスレイマン1世が第10代皇帝に即位し、以降46年に渡る華麗なるオスマン帝国統治の歴史が始まる。スレイマンの即位と同じ頃、ルテニア（現在のウクライナ）では、タタール人による襲撃が続いていた。ある小さな町の司祭の美しい娘アレクサンドラ（後のヒュッレム）は、目の前で家族、そして恋人を皆殺しにされる悲劇に襲われる。その美しい美貌で命拾いしたアレクサンドラは捕虜となり、幼なじみのマリアとともにオスマン帝国のハレムに献上されるため、奴隷船に乗せられた。ハレムに入ったアレクサンドラは、絶望のあまり死ぬことさえも恐れず、全てに反抗的な態度でいたが、ある夜、夢枕に立った両親の言葉に後押しされ、このハレムで生き抜くことを決意するのだった。
overviews.pl: Zrealizowana z rozmachem kostiumowa produkcja opowiada o życiu sułtana Sulejmana Wspaniałego, najdłużej panującego władcy Imperium Osmańskiego i jego miłości do pięknej Roksolany, niewolnicy wziętej w jasyr w dalekim słowiańskim kraju. Pod tureckim imieniem Hürrem („radosna”) zrewolucjonizowała harem w ówczesnym imperium i zapoczątkowała Erę Sułtanek w Turcji.
overviews.pt: Aos 26 anos, quando iniciou seu reinado, o sultão Solimão almejava construir um império mais poderoso que o de Alexandre, o Grande, e tornar os otomanos invencíveis. Ao longo de seus 46 anos de reinado, sua fama...
overviews.ar: يتناول المسلسل ما يجري داخل مقر الحريم بقصر السلطان والمعروف بالحرملك، وفي الوقت ذاته يستعرض المسلسل قصص الحب وعلاقات السلطان سليمان بالنساء، ووقوعه في حب إحدى الجاريات التي تتحكم في مصير الدولة العثمانية.

Grand Vizier İbrahim Pasha’s political brilliance begins to crack under the weight of his pride, secret love affair, and

items.title: Sins and Roses
items.overview: As a boy, Serhat lost both his father and fortune but built an empire on family and integrity. His world shatters when his wife Berrak hides a devastating secret and falls into a coma. While searching for answers, his heart hardens—until he meets Zeynep, a passionate florist chasing the same truth, igniting a journey of trust, passion, and redemption.

overviews.ru:
Серхат — успешный бизнесмен, счастливый муж и прекрасный отец. Он долгие годы был уверен, что ему удалось построить крепкую и любящую семью. Однако совершенно случайно Серхат узнает, что его супруга, с которой он прожил 18 лет вместе и которая родила ему близнецов, на протяжении многих лет изменяла ему. Более того, у нее даже есть маленькая дочь, которую она родила живя в браке с ним. Ситуацию осложняет и тот факт, что в результате трагической случайности Беррак — жена Серхата впадает в кому, а он сам решает начать расследование, которое бы помогло ему узнать всю правду о своей семье.

Поиски приводят мужчину в трущобы Стамбула, где он случайно знакомится с молодой девушкой по имени Зейнеп. Разница в возрасте и социальном статусе не смогла стать преградой для их чувств. Только вот и Серхат, и Зейнеп, понимают, что им будет трудно построить крепкие отношения. К тому же отец девушки, категорически против ее сближения с бизнесменом.
overviews.ar: رجل فقد والده وثروته وهو طفل، لكنه بنى إمبراطورية على أساس العائلة والنزاهة. تتبدل حياته عندما تخفي زوجته سرًا مدمرًا وتدخل في غيبوبة. أثناء بحثه عن الإجابات، يقسو قلبه، حتى يلتقي بصانعة الزهور الشغوفة التي تسعى وراء نفس الحقيقة، مما يشعل رحلة من الثقة والشغف والخلاص.
overviews.tr: Hayatını dürüstlük, aile sevgisi ve güven üzerine kuran Serhat’ın, eşi Berrak’ın yıllardır sakladığı büyük bir sırrı öğrenmesiyle alt üst olan hayatına odaklanıyor. Serhat’ın yolu, dobra ve cesur tavırlarıyla dikkat çeken Zeynep’le kesiştiğinde ikili kendilerini büyük bir fırtınanın içinde buluyor.
overviews.es:
De niño, Serhat perdió a su padre y su fortuna, pero logró construir un imperio basado en la familia y la integridad. Su mundo se desmorona cuando su esposa, Berrak, cae en coma ocultando un devastador secreto.

Mientras busca respuestas, su corazón se endurece... hasta que conoce a Zeynep, una apasionada florista que persigue la misma verdad. Juntos encenderán un viaje de confianza, pasión y redención.

¿Podrá el amor sanar las heridas del pasado o los secretos terminarán por destruirlos?

items.title: Kızılcık Şerbeti
items.overview: When free-spirited Doğa falls head over heels for charming Fatih, nobody expects the chaos that follows. His family is deeply conservative and devout; hers is modern and secular — and neither side is ready to back down. What starts as a love story quickly becomes a collision of two very different Turkeys, played out through family dinners, in-law battles and everything in between. Sharp, relatable and impossible to stop watching.

overviews.tr: Farklı kültürlere sahip iki ailenin çocukları Doğa ve Fatih’in yıldırım nikahıyla evlenmesinin ardından gelişen çarpıcı olayları konu alıyor.
overviews.ar: نتابع القصة الآسرة لامرأة مثالية تقع في حب رجل وسيم من عائلة متدينة تتعارض قيمها مع قيم والدتها، فيسعى كل منهما للتغلب على تلك الخلافات والانسجام.
overviews.ru: Кывылджым — современная молодая женщина, хорошо образованная и реально смотрящая на жизнь. После развода с мужем она научилась крепко стоять на ногах и одна вырастила двух дочек — Догу и Чимен. Чимен пока учится в колледже, а Дога в университете, на факультете стоматологии. На первом же курсе Дога влюбляется и выходит замуж за своего однокурсника Фатиха. Кывылджым разочарована, что дочь так рано вышла замуж, не успев окончить учебу. Но еще больше озабочена тем, в какую семью она попала, считая что ее дочь не сможет с ними ужиться. А семья Фатиха очень строгая, приверженная традициям. Однако Дога и Фатих считают, что их любовь способна преодолеть любые разногласия. История двух семей с одинаковыми истинами, но разными культурами.
overviews.es: 'Mundo opuestos' narra la historia de amor entre Doğa y Fatih, dos jóvenes que provienen de mundos completamente diferentes y que han sido criados de formas muy distintas. Mientras Doğa ha sido educada por su madre, Kıvılcım, una mujer moderna, luchadora y liberal en un ambiente mucho más abierto, Fatih ha crecido en el seno de una familia conservadora y tradicional. Sin embargo, aunque esas diferencias no son un problema para ellos si lo son para sus familias, que chocan una y otra vez. Los enfrentamientos se suceden y eso genera una tensión que cada vez va a más y que podría poner en peligro la historia de amor de los protagonistas. La situación es insostenible ya que la familia del joven nunca aceptará a Doğa y hará lo imposible por arruinar su relación.
overviews.pt: Trata-se dos acontecimentos marcantes que se desenvolvem após o casamento de Doğa e Fatih, filhos de duas famílias de culturas diferentes, num casamento relâmpago.
overviews.pl: Współczesny serial obyczajowy, w którym prywatne wybory młodych ludzi prowadzą do otwartego konfliktu wartości, światopoglądów i rodzinnych oczekiwań. Jedno uczucie uruchamia ciąg zdarzeń, których konsekwencje wykraczają daleko poza życie dwojga bohaterów.

items.title: Yalı Çapkını
items.overview: When Istanbul playboy Ferit Korhan's exasperated grandfather arranges his marriage to a girl from Gaziantep, fate intervenes — Ferit falls for Seyran, the younger sister of his intended bride, upending both families.

overviews.tr: Yalı Çapkını, Gaziantepli Korhan Ailesi'nin direği Halis Ağa'nın (Çetin Tekindor) el bebek gül bebek yetiştirilmiş torunu Ferit'in (Mert Ramazan Demir) evlenmesine karar vermesiyle gelişecek olayları konu alıyor.
overviews.ru: Ферит – настоящий баловень судьбы. Его отец Халис Ага - состоятельный человек, поэтому герой привык ни в чем себе не отказывать. Жизнь Ферита состоит из постоянных вечеринок и череды новых романов. Не обращая внимания на наставления отца, он проводит время в сомнительных компаниях и не желает меняться. Халис Ага принимает решение женить непутевого наследника, чтобы избежать семейного позора. Он сам выбирает сыну невесту, которая идеально подходит на роль жены. Сейран работает врачом в городской клинике. Девушка красивая и умная. Проблема в том, что она совершенно не хочет замуж, а жених вне себя от услышанной новости...
overviews.pt: Halis Korhan é o dono de um grande império de joias e o chefe da família Korhan. Embora seu filho Orhan e seu neto mais velho Fuat administrem a maior parte dos negócios, ele ainda toma as decisões mais importantes da empresa. Enquanto isso, seu neto mais novo Ferit é o oposto de seu irmão Fuat. O jovem é um solteiro muito irresponsável que acabou de voltar do exterior, onde foi estudar. Halis não aguenta mais a imprudência de Ferit e ele pede sua nora viúva Ifakat para encontrar uma esposa para seu neto.
overviews.es: Halis Korhan, desesperado por enderezar el rumbo de su nieto Ferit, decide casarlo para poner fin a su comportamiento irresponsable. Sin embargo, los planes toman un giro inesperado cuando Ferit se enamora de Seyran. Este romance no solo altera el destino de la pareja, sino también el de toda la familia, desatando conflictos y secretos ocultos.
overviews.ar: لتلقين حفيده الطائش والمتهور درسا، يقرر كبير العائلة الغني هاليس آغا أن يزوجه بابنة عائلة من مسقط رأسه.
overviews.pl: Jest to pełna humoru historia o Fericie, członku zamożnej rodziny z reputacją uwodziciela. Jego dziadek, Halis Ağa, niezadowolony z rozwiązłego życia wnuka, postanawia zainterweniować.

items.title: This Sea Will Overflow
items.overview: In a land where people are accustomed to battling fierce waves and constant storms, the story of a woman who stands tall on her feet, with all her emotional strength, resilience and endurance, and a man who is passionate about his "love" and who competes with the storms of the Black Sea and struggles with its waves, comes to the screens with an effective script... The ups and downs of the mountains, the sea and the human soul are told through the eyes of a stranger who finds himself in the middle of the endless war between two mortal enemies.

overviews.ru:
Юная Элени Мирьяно приезжает в Трабзон. Именно здесь она хочет узнать всю правду о своей семье и своем появлении на свет. Девушка даже и не догадывалась, что ее прибытие изменит привычный быт сразу нескольких семей.

Кланы Фуртуна и Кочари уже давно враждуют. Однако много лет назад это не помешало Эсме и Адилю полюбить друг друга. Но создать собственную семью молодым людям так и не удалось, и на несколько лет их пути разошлись.

Приезд Элени в Трабзон вынуждает Адиля и Эсме снова встретиться, и на этот раз их будут связывать не только теплые чувства друг к другу.
overviews.tr: Hırçın dalgalarla, dinmez fırtınalarla mücadele etmeye alışmış insanların coğrafyasında, ayakları üzerinde dimdik duran, tüm duygusallığı, dirayeti ve direnci ile bir kadının ve Karadeniz’in fırtınalarıyla yarışan, dalgalarıyla boğuşan “sevdasına” tutkun bir erkeğin hikâyesi etkili bir senaryo eşliğinde ekranlara geliyor… Can düşmanı iki ailenin bitmeyen savaşının ortasında kendini bulan bir yabancının gözünden; dağların, denizin ve insan ruhunun iniş çıkışları anlatılıyor…
overviews.ar: تشتعل الأحداث بصراع طويل الأمد بين عائلة فُرتونا وعائلة كوتشاري، حيث تتحرك خيوطه بين الانتقام والطمع والحب والخيانة وتتعقد الأمور بعد ظهور شخصية إليني، الفتاة القادمة من أثينا للبحث عن جذورها، والتي تفتح أبوابًا ماضية مغلقة. كما أن خروج "شريف" زوج إسمي من السجن يشعل التوتر ويقلب موازين القوى.
overviews.es:
En una tierra donde la gente está acostumbrada a batallar contra olas feroces y tormentas constantes, llega a las pantallas la historia de una mujer que se mantiene en pie con toda su fuerza emocional, resiliencia y resistencia, y la de un hombre apasionado por su amor, que compite con los temporales del Mar Negro y lucha contra su oleaje.

Los altibajos de las montañas, el mar y el alma humana se relatan a través de los ojos de un extraño que se encuentra en medio de una guerra sin fin entre dos enemigos mortales.

¿Podrá el amor sobrevivir en un territorio donde la naturaleza y el odio humano son igual de implacables?

items.title: The Pit
items.overview: When a mafia family named Koçovars are in danger of losing control of their neighborhood, “The Pit,” their youngest son must come back home, a place he could never truly escape.

overviews.tr: İstanbul’un en belalı mahallerinden Çukur’un kontrolü Koçova ailesinin elindedir. Koçovalıların Çukur’u yönetirken en önemli kuralları da uyuşturucuya asla izin vermemeleridir. Ancak gözünü bu mahalleye dikmiş ve bu yasağı kırmaya hazırlanan yeni bir grubun ortaya çıkması ile mevcut düzen bozulur.
overviews.bg: Опасен квартал "The Pit", ръководен от семейство от благородна мафия, наречено Koçovars. Когато семейството е в опасност да загуби контрола на "Ямата", най-малкият им син сега трябва да се върне в дома си, откъдето никога не би могъл да избяга.
overviews.ru: На окраине Стамбула расположен район Чукур. Многие годы этим районом управляет семья Кочовалы, и одно из главных их условий – не распространять наркотики. Однако появляется группа недовольных, и они решают взять управление районом в свои руки. В это же время из Парижа возвращается младший сын семьи Кочовалы – Ямач, который покинул отчий дом много лет назад. Вместе с ним приезжает Сена - девушка, которой он клялся в любви. Но смогут ли молодые люди быть счастливы в Чукуре?
overviews.ar: تدور أحداث المسلسل في أخطر حي في إسطنبول، الذي تسيطر عليه عائلة "كوشوفالي". تُعتبر المتاجرة بالمخدرات ممنوعة في هذا الحي. ياماش (أراس بولوت إينيملي)، الابن الأصغر لعائلة "كوشوفالي"، قرر ترك الحي وعائلته وراءه ليبدأ حياة جديدة بعيدًا عنهم. يتعرف ياماش على فتاة جميلة ويقع في حبها، ويخطط للزواج منها. لكن حياته تنقلب عندما تأتي والدته وتطلب منه العودة إلى الحي المعروف باسم "الحفرة" لأنه في حاجة إليه، خاصة بعد وفاة أخيه الأكبر كهرمان، الذي كان يدير شؤون الحي. يعود ياماش إلى الحفرة، ليجد نفسه في وسط مغامرات ومؤامرات للسيطرة على الحي
overviews.fr: Un quartier dangereux est dirigé par une famille de la mafia noble appelée Koçovars. Lorsque la famille court le risque de perdre le contrôle du quartier, leur plus jeune fils doit rentrer chez lui, d'où il ne pourrait jamais s'échapper.
overviews.es: Zuleyha y Yilmaz sueñan con casarse, hasta que un criminal intenta abusar de ella.

seasonList.overview: The Pit (Ç​ukur), that İdris Koçovalı has built with his own hands, is the heart of İstanbul; in fact it is Istanbul! seasonList.overview: It's the end of an era in The Pit. Although İdris Koçovalı's words saying, "They think that The Pit is in Istanbul but they don't know that Istanbul is in The Pit" echo in the destroyed streets of the neighborhood, there's no sign of those days. The condition of the Koçovalı's who lost power after a

seasonList.overview: The Koçovalıs are facing the greatest sorrow of their lives! As a result of Yücel’s set up Yamaç or İdris are forced to shoot the other. Nothing will ever be the same in The Pit. The cards will be dealt once again as Akın Koçovalı takes control while Baykal’s daughter Efsun comes to the neighborhood
