items.title: İşler Güçler
items.overview: İşler Güçler, is a Turkish comedy series which first aired on 28 June 2012 on Star TV and tells the story of 3 actors, with the motto, Modern Muzip Yalanlar. Ahmet Kural, Murat Cemcir and Sadi Celil Cengiz shares the leading roles. Although rumour had it that it was going to be over at the end of the summer, the board of Star TV made an explanation that they would go on issuing it in the 2012−13 publication season, due to the interest their fans had shown

overviews.tr: Ahmet, Murat ve Sadi film çekme hayalleri kuran ve parayı toplamak için 'Meslek Hikayeleri' adlı belgesel-programda sunuculuk yapan üç aktördür. Amaçları bu programdan para topladıktan sonra gişe rekorları kıracak bir film çekmektir. Fakat çektikleri program yayınlanmayınca daha iyi bir bölüm çekmek için kolları sıvarlar. Ahmet, başrol oynadığı günlerin özlemini çekmekte, mazideki başarılarının göz ardı edilmesinden şikayet etmektedir. Kendisinin artık tanınmadığını düşünmekte ve bu yüzden herkese sitem etmektedir. Murat, mesleğinin gereklerini yapmaya çalışırken kendisini terk etmiş olan eski sevgilisiyle beraber çalışmanın zorluklarını yaşamaktadır. Sadi, gümrük memurluğunu oyuncu olmak için bırakmış, para dertleri ve ailevi sorunlarla uğraşmaktadır. Figüranlık yaptığı dizisinden başka gelir kaynağı olmayan Sadi için "Meslek Hikayeleri"nin yayınlanması ve ücretlerini almaları çok önemlidir.

items.title: Sıfır Bir
items.overview: The story of a group of young people who live in Adana – Hürriyet District got involved in illegal businesses and became Adana's strongest gang over time. The series, which started as an independent production in 2016 and broadcast on Youtube, has been transferred to Blutv with all its episodes as of the 3rd season.

overviews.tr: Adana'nın Hürriyet Mahallesi'nde yaşayan; yasa dışı yollara bulaşıp zamanla Adana'nın en güçlü çetesi olan bir grup gencin hikayesi.

seasonList.name: Season 1
seasonList.overview: Savaş, Cio and Özgür were born and raised in Adana's Hürriyet District. In this region of Adana, where the unemployment rate is very high, these 3 young people in their 20s involved in crimes such as theft, assault, injury and even murder, start to struggle with crimes such as drugs and prostitution

seasonList.name: Season 2
seasonList.overview: Savaş and his gang took the revenge of Sarsılmaz. However, Cio and Garip were shot, and the rest of the team hid in a safe house. The neighborhood is now entrusted to the young people of the gang. Savaş has made a great enemy in his war on drugs and women trafficking. Will Savaş be able to notice th

seasonList.name: Season 3
seasonList.overview: The wedding of Anafor, a member of Savaş’s gang, was raided, Hülya and many innocent people were injured. While the gang tries to recover, they will also start to fight against this powerful enemy. This unexpected attack will deeply affect Savaş, Özgür and Cio, and from time to time they will rememb

seasonList.name: Season 4
seasonList.overview: While Savaş and his gang put up a fight behind the bars, problems started to arise in the neighborhood. Cihat is still a fugitive and he is trying to deal with serious problems outside. A tough and bloody struggle awaits Savaş, Cio and Özgür behind the bars where everyone is trying to establish thei

seasonList.name: Season 5
seasonList.overview: Savaş and Cihat will find themselves in a great danger before they have time to experience the sorrow of their losses. As the fight in the neighborhood and behind bars continues, the new targets of the other side, Savaş and Cihat, will fight for their lives to survive and avenge their losses.

seasonList.name: Season 6
seasonList.overview: The gang is searching for Gökhan everywhere, who betrayed them and was hiding. Cihat, shaken by the betrayal of his cousin, was caught by the police in the place where he was hiding and sent to prison next to Savaş. Savaş, on the other hand, survived the attack on him in prison, and he yearns for re

overviews.tr: Orta halli bir İstanbul mahallesine konuğuz bu Ramazan. Kaybolmaya yüz tutmuş, bizi biz yapan ve birbirimize bağlayan tüm değerlerimize sımsıkı sarılmış, bir avuç insanın misafiriyiz. Oruç tutmanın sadece aç kalmak olmadığının bilincinde, helal dairenin keyfinin kafi olduğunun idrakinde ve harama lüzumsuz gözüyle bakan, her sene Ramazan ayında yaşadıklarımızı yaşayan insanlardır bize kapılarını açanlar. "Nerede o eski Ramazanlar?" demeyen insanlardır. O eski Ramazanları yaşarlar hala.

Biri spor foto muhabiri diğeri ise spor yazarı olan Rafet ile Saffet birbirinden ayrılmaz iki arkadaştırlar. Rafet gamsız, vurdumduymaz, dağınık ve çapkın; Saffet ise derli toplu, titiz, becerikli ve duygulu bir kişiliğe sahiptir. Bu iki arkadaşın hayatta birleştirdiği tek nokta vardır, ikisinin de karılarından ayrılıp aynı evde yaşamaya mecbur olmalarıdır.

items.title: Peddi
items.overview: In a village that doesn't officially exist, a laborer's unmatched athletic talent becomes his weapon to fight for his people's right to be recognized.

overviews.de: Im ländlichen Andhra Pradesh der 1980er Jahre schweißt ein temperamentvoller Dorfbewohner seine Gemeinde durch den Sport zusammen, um ihren Stolz gegen einen mächtigen Rivalen zu verteidigen.
overviews.pt: Na zona rural de Andhra Pradesh, na década de 1980, um corajoso aldeão une a sua comunidade através do desporto para defender o seu orgulho contra um rival poderoso.
overviews.ru: В 2016 году чиновник из Министерства спорта получает выговор от министра за неудовлетворительные результаты Индии на Олимпийских играх. Во время поездки в город в Андхра-Прадеше чиновник наблюдает за местной молодежью, демонстрирующей исключительную преданность легкой атлетике. Все они считают своим вдохновителем человека по имени Педди. Заинтригованный чиновник отправляется в трудный путь через леса и холмы, чтобы добраться до отдаленной безымянной деревни на вершине холма и узнать историю Педди...
overviews.es: En una aldea sin nombre ni reconocimiento oficial, un trabajador se vale de su impresionante talento deportivo para luchar por los derechos de su gente.
overviews.ar: تدور أحداث العمل في ريف ولاية أندرا براديش خلال ثمانينات القرن الماضي، يوحد قروي متحمس مجتمعه من خلال الرياضة للدفاع عن كرامتهم في مواجهة منافس قوي.

items.title: RRR
items.overview: A fictional history of two legendary revolutionaries' journey away from home before they began fighting for their country in the 1920s.

overviews.de: Eine fiktive Geschichte zweier legendärer Revolutionäre, die von zu Hause wegreisen, bevor sie in den 1920er Jahren begannen, für ihr Land zu kämpfen.
overviews.ru: Британская Индия. Рама — преданный полицейский на службе у колониального правительства, способный расправиться с толпой в одиночку, и местные считают его предателем. Бхим — парень из племени гондов, который вынужден отправиться в Дели на поиски похищенной губернатором маленькой соплеменницы. Узнав об этом, губернатор объявляет награду за его поимку, и, чтобы продвинуться по службе, Рама берётся за это задание. Спасая упавшего в реку мальчика, Рама и Бхим становятся друзьями. Они не знают ни настоящих личностей, ни скрытых мотивов друг друга, но это знакомство положит начало большим переменам.
overviews.es: Un cuento de ficción sobre dos revolucionarios indios legendarios y su viaje lejos de casa antes de que comenzaran a luchar por su país en la década de 1920.
overviews.fr: Inde coloniale, années 1920. Deux hommes d’une détermination de fer se rencontrent par hasard et nouent une amitié fulgurante : Komaram Bheem, guerrier gond déterminé à arracher une fillette de sa tribu des griffes du gouverneur britannique, et Alluri Sitarama Raju, un mystérieux officier militaire au service de l’Empire, aux motivations impénétrables. Le destin poussera ces deux « frères de cœur » à un affrontement inévitable, jusqu’à ce qu’une vérité inattendue éclate.
overviews.it: Una storia immaginaria del viaggio di due leggendari rivoluzionari lontano da casa prima che iniziassero a combattere per il loro paese negli anni '20.
overviews.pt: Um guerreiro corajoso em uma missão perigosa encontra um policial durão que serve ao exército britânico nesta saga épica ambientada na Índia pré-independência.
overviews.tr: Rama, sömürge hükümetinin hizmetinde, kalabalıkla tek başına başa çıkabilen özel bir polis memurudur ve yerel halk onu bir hain olarak görür. Bhim, vali tarafından kaçırılan küçük bir kabile kadınını aramak için Delhi'ye gitmek zorunda kalan Gond kabilesinden bir adamdır. Bunu öğrenen vali, yakalanması için bir ödül ilan eder ve hizmette ilerlemek için Rama bu görevi üstlenir. Nehre düşen bir çocuğu kurtaran Rama ve Bhim arkadaş olurlar. Birbirlerinin gerçek kimliklerini veya art niyetlerini bilmiyorlar ama bu tanışma büyük değişimleri başlatacak.
overviews.ko: 위험한 임무에 나선 용맹한 전사. 영국을 위해 일하는 냉혹한 경찰과 맞대결을 펼친다. 독립 이전의 인도를 배경으로 한 대서사극.
overviews.ar: تدور الأحداث في إطار من الحركة حول اثنين من الثوار الأسطوريين، ورحلتهما بعيدا عن وطنهما قبل البدء في القتال من أجل بلدهما في فترة العشرينات بالقرن العشرين.
overviews.ja: 舞台は1920年、英国植民地時代のインド。英国軍にさらわれた幼い少女を救うため、立ち上がるビーム。大義のため英国政府の警察となるラーマ。熱い思いを胸に秘めた男たちが運命に導かれて出会い、唯一無二の親友となる。しかし、ある事件をきっかけに究極の選択を迫られることに。彼らが選ぶのは、友情か？使命か？
overviews.pl: Fikcyjna historia dwóch legendarnych rewolucjonistów i ich życiowej drogi do walki o niepodległość swojej ojczyzny. Film zdobył nagrodę Oscara, 5 innych nagród i 26 nominacji
overviews.bg: Те са синове на индийската нация, вървят по един път, но преследват различни цели. Във вените им тече една кръв, а съдбата ги наказва да са врагове. Единият е офицер към  Британския Радж, а другият e Робин Худ на селяните от бедните касти. Дългът към мисията ги изправя един срещу друг, но случайността ги прави приятели. Днес трябва да направят избор, дали да враждуват в името на личната кауза или заедно да се опълчат срещу Короната.

items.title: Korean Kanakaraju
items.overview: Possessed by a Korean spirit, Kanakaraju must navigate his new supernatural identity to protect his family and solve the spirit's murder.

items.title: Lenin
items.overview: In a village trapped by generations of bloodshed, a determined young man dares to challenge the traditions fueling an endless cycle of violence.

items.title: Bāhubali 2: The Conclusion
items.overview: When Mahendra, the son of Bāhubali, learns about his heritage, he begins to look for answers. His story is juxtaposed with past events that unfolded in the Mahishmati Kingdom.

overviews.es: El amor entre dos jóvenes se vera truncado,pero tendrán una segunda oportunidad en otra vida paralela.
overviews.de: Als Mahendra, der Sohn von Baahubali, von seiner Herkunft erfährt, begibt er sich auf die Suche nach Antworten. Seine Geschichte wird Ereignissen aus der Vergangenheit im Königreich Mahishmati gegenübergestellt.
overviews.pt: Na Índia antiga, um homem aventureiro e ousado envolve-se numa disputa de décadas entre duas pessoas guerreiras.
overviews.tr: Şaşalı eski bir krallığın taht kavgaları sonucunda asıl varis olarak dünyaya gelen prensin kundakta uğradığı suikastten annesinin yardımı ile hayatta kalmayı başararır. Lakin bu başarı Baahubali’yi gerçek annesinden ve benliğinden habersiz büyümesine nedenn olur. Aradan uzun yıllar geçerek Baahubali yetişkin, güçlü, çevik, atik, zeki, gözü pek ve dövüş konusunda maheretli bir bir birey olarak yetişir. Sonrasında alında da yazılı olan kader yolunu takip ederek asıl benliğini bulması ile hakkı olan ülkesinin padişahlığına oturarak ülkesinin savaş eşiğine gelmesi ile olaylara hükmetmeye çalışıyor.
overviews.ru: Старый Каттаппа рассказывает Шиве, почему убил его отца Амарендру. После того, как тот был усыновлён королевой Сивагами, старший сводный брат Бхаллаладева всегда ему завидовал. Зависть достигла апогея после битвы с дикими племенами, когда Сивагами нарекла младшего сына наследником королевства. Бхаллаладева и его хитрый дядя начинают плести грязные интриги, чтобы сжить Амарендру со свету.
overviews.ko: 선왕 바후발리와 데바세나와의 사랑 그리고 그의 죽음과 마히쉬마티 제국의 몰락에 대한 이야기가 스크린으로 펼쳐진다. 그리고 자신의 출생의 비밀을 알게 된 시부두는 과연 발랄라데바의 폭정으로부터 백성을 구할 수 있을 것인가.
overviews.bg: Когато Шива, синът на Бахубали, научава за наследството си, започва да търси отговори. Историята му е съпоставена с минали събития, случили се в царство Махишмати.
overviews.fr: Shivudu, un jeune villageois découvre sa vraie identité, de descendance royale. Il sauvera la Reine Devasena asservie par le terrible Bhalladeva dont le seul et unique objectif est de garder son trône et, de tuer le fils de son ennemi : le Roi BAAHUBALI.
overviews.ja: ある日、シヴドゥは自分が今や人々の語り草となっている伝説のヒーロー、バーフバリの息子だと知る。彼は父親の家臣カッタッパから父はある人物の裏切り行為により命を落とし、王座を追われたという話を聞く。かつて父バーフバリはカーラケーヤとの戦いに勝利し、国母シヴァガミから王位継承者として認められ……。 伝説の戦士バーフバリの壮大な物語を描いたアクション『バーフバリ　伝説誕生』の完結編。インドの王国を舞台に、祖父から孫の三代にわたる愛と裏切りと復讐（ふくしゅう）を描く。前作同様プラバースが主人公を演じ、ラーナー・ダッグバーティ、アヌシュカ・シェッティ、タマンナー、ナーサルらも続投。監督・脚本のS・S・ラージャマウリ、撮影のK・K・センティル・クマール、音楽のM・M・キーラヴァーニらスタッフも再び集結した。
overviews.it: Shivudu, un giovane abitante del villaggio scopre la sua vera identità, di discendenza reale. Salverà la regina Devasena schiava del terribile Bhalladeva il cui unico obiettivo è mantenere il suo trono e, uccidere il figlio del suo nemico: il re BAAHUBALI.

items.title: Raakaasa
items.overview: Returning home after a decade, an NRI chasing romance inadvertently awakens an ancient darkness long feared by his village. As the threat intensifies, love turns deadly and life hangs in the balance.

overviews.it: Tornato a casa dopo un decennio, un indiano residente all'estero, in cerca d'amore, risveglia inavvertitamente un'antica oscurità temuta da tempo dal suo villaggio. Mentre la minaccia si intensifica, l'amore si trasforma in una tragedia e la vita è appesa a un filo.
overviews.fr: Rentré au village pour se marier après dix ans passés aux États-Unis, l'insouciant Veerababu réveille sans le savoir un ancien démon amateur de sacrifices humains.
overviews.es: Tras pasar diez años en Estados Unidos, Veerababu regresa a casa para asistir a una boda y, sin saberlo, despierta un espíritu ancestral que exige sacrificios humanos.

items.title: Nagabandham: The Secret Treasure
items.overview: A chosen warrior protects a mystical, serpent-bound Himalayan temple from those seeking to steal the power of the Brahma Kamalam, a divine relic.

overviews.ru: В центре сюжета — два священных артефакта: древний манускрипт и мистический цветок Брахма Камалам, обладающий невероятной силой. Хранящиеся в храме Ранганатхасвами в Шрирангапатнаме, они способны открыть портал к сокровищу, меняющему судьбу Индии. Спустя века после афганского вторжения враг Абдали возвращается за артефактами, чтобы обрести божественную мощь. На его пути встаёт деревенский юноша Рудра, чья жизнь переворачивается после трагедии на свадьбе сестры. Встретив Нага-садху, он узнаёт о своей божественной миссии. Теперь Рудра должен защитить реликвии и остановить врага, пока тот не разбудил древнее проклятие и не погрузил мир в хаос.

items.title: Maa Inti Bangaram
items.overview: Through both her moments of fear and bravery, a woman discovers that embracing her vulnerabilities is as vital to her inner strength as facing challenges head-on.

overviews.ru: Бывшая наёмная убийца Сварна пытается начать новую жизнь и спустя два года брака впервые приезжает в семью мужа Анирудха. Девушка изо всех сил пытается произвести хорошее впечатление на родственников и соответствовать идеальной невестке. Однако её благие намерения рушатся, когда в городке появляется Каруна - опасный человек из её тёмного прошлого. Чтобы защитить новую семью, которая ничего не знает о её прежней жизни, Сварне приходится вернуться к старым навыкам и дать бой врагам, готовым уничтожить всё, что ей дорого.

items.title: Bāhubali: The Beginning
items.overview: The young Shivudu is left as a foundling in a small village by his mother. By the time he’s grown up, it has become apparent that he possesses exceptional gifts. He meets the beautiful warrior princess Avanthika and learns that her queen has been held captive for the last 25 years. Shividu sets off to rescue her, discovering his own origins in the process.

overviews.ru: Всё начинается со спасения ребенка, которого должны были убить солдаты, посланные правителем королевства Махишмати. Спустя годы мальчик превращается в крепкого и рослого юношу Шивуду. Однажды он находит маску и решает во что бы то ни стало разыскать её владельца, не подозревая, что она принадлежит прекрасной воительнице, которая всем своим кланом пытается вызволить из плена королеву Девасену, заточенную жестоким тираном Бхаллалой Девой.
overviews.pt: O rei de Mahishmati, Amarendra Baahubali e sua esposa Devasena, governaram o reino onde as pessoas viviam em paz e prosperidade, até que um cruel ministro se junta com o rei Bhallaladeva e captura o reino, matando Baahubali numa grande guerra. Para evitar ameaças, Bhallaladeva manda matar Devasena e seu filho, que conseguiram fugir. Agora, o filho de Baahubali, Shivudu, que é secretamente criado pela mãe de Bhallaladeva, volta para resgatar o reino dos seus pais.
overviews.es: Una disputa entre hermanos que se extiende a través de dos generaciones. Esta es la primera parte de un drama contado en dos partes. La primera parte muestra los hermanos Baahubali y Bhallaladeva luchando por el trono del reino Mahishmathi.
overviews.ko: 폭포 아래로 기적처럼 살아 떠밀려 온 갓난 아기. 그 곳에 사는 한 여인은 아이의 목숨을 구하고 정성을 다해 키우지만 아이는 자랄수록 자신이 발견 된 폭포 위 절벽 너머의 세상에 대한 집착을 멈추지 않는다. 결국 성인이 된 아이는 폭포 너머에서 범상치 않은 부름의 기운을 느끼고 수 백 번의 시행착오 끝에 절벽을 올라 그 곳에서 운명적 여인 ‘아반티카’를 만난다. 반란군의 전사이자 25년간 포로로 잡혀 있는 ‘데바세나’ 공주를 구하는 것이 임무인 ‘아반티카’와 사랑에 빠지고만 그는, 과거 왕국의 후계자였던 아버지에 얽힌 엄청난 비밀과 자신이 왕국을 구할 전설 속 전사 ‘바후발리’라는 진실을 알고 큰 혼란에 빠진다. ‘아반티카’와 함께 공주를 구하기 위해 복수의 반격을 시작한 전사 ‘바후발리’...  과연 그의 운명은?
overviews.de: Als kleines Baby im Fluss ausgesetzt, wächst Shivudu gut behütet bei seiner neuen Familie auf. Aus ihm wird ein junger, starker Mann mit ungeahnten Fähigkeiten. Per Zufall trifft er auf die Amazone Avanthika die es sich zum Ziel gemacht hat, die gefangen gehaltene Königin Devasena aus dem Königreich Mahishmati zu befreien. Auf deren Thron hat es sich der brutale Bhallala Deva bequem gemacht, der mit allen Mitteln an der Macht bleiben will. Shivudu macht sich mit Avanthika auf die Königin zu befreien, dabei enthüllt er eine tragische Wahrheit, die sein Schicksal in eine ganz neue Richtung lenkt.
overviews.fr: Shivudu, recueilli au berceau par des villageois, grandi au pied d'une immense cascade. Malgré l'interdiction de sa mère, son rêve a toujours été de franchir cette frontière naturelle et d'explorer le monde caché en amont. Une étrange jeune fille lui apparaît un jour et l'invite à la suivre. Shivudu, mesmérisé, parvient enfin à escalader jusqu'au sommet. Ce monde nouveau, qui se découvre alors devant lui, lui réservera bien des surprises.
overviews.tr: İki erkek kardeş arasında iki jenerasyondur devam eden çekişme anlatılıyor. İki bölüm olacak serinin ilk bölümüdür. İlk bölümde Baahubali ve Bhallaladeva kardeşlerin Mahishmathi Krallığının tahtı için verdikleri savaş işleniyor.
overviews.bg: Когато Санга и съпругът й спасяват пеленаче от реката, не подозират нито чие е, нито какво бъдеще го очаква. Хлапето израства свободно с дух на приключенец. Повече от всичко на света иска да изучава планините и в това време научава за корените си. Осъзнава смисъла на живота си и се изправя срещу могъщия Балалдева.
overviews.ja: 赤ん坊を抱えた高貴な女性が大勢の兵士たちに追われていた。滝つぼまで追い詰められた彼女は赤ん坊を救うため命を落としてしまうが、赤ん坊は村人に拾われ助かった。シヴドゥと名付けられ勇ましい青年へと成長した彼は、滝の上の世界に興味を持ち始める。そしてある日ついに頂上の大地へとたどり着き、美しい女戦士アヴァンティカと出会い恋に落ちる。彼女の一族は暴君バラーラデーヴァが統治する王国と戦いを続けており、そのことを知ったシヴドゥは自ら戦士となって王国へと乗り込んで行った。そこで彼は、王妃でありながら25年間も幽閉されている実の母の存在と、自分がこの国の王子バーフバリであることを初めて知る。その背景には、50年前に祖父が建国し、父が王だった平和な時代に、蛮族の侵略による国家存続の危機と王宮を揺るがす王位継承争いという因縁の戦いの歴史があったのだ──！
overviews.it: Nell'antico regno di Mahishmathi , una donna con in braccio un bambino è inseguita da due soldati, dopo averli uccisi scivola e cade in nelle turbinose acque di un fiume; l'acqua la sommerge ma tenendo il bambino fuori dall'acqua con una mano riesce ad impedire che affoghi anche lui. Il piccolo viene salvato dagli abitanti del villaggio e adottato da Sanga e suo marito. Nominato Shivudu, cresce fino a diventare un giovane uomo forte e avventuroso, incuriosito dalla cascata e dalle terre misteriose sopra di essa. Dopo aver trovato una maschera di legno caduta proprio dalla cima della montagna, viene spinto a trovare il proprietario della maschera e riesce a scalare la cascata. La maschera appartiene ad Avanthika, una guerriera ribelle facente parte di un gruppo guidato dal fratello di Devasena impegnato nella guerriglia contro l'imperatore Bhallaladeva

items.title: Mayalokam
items.overview: Mayalokam is a 1945 Telugu-language film produced and directed by Gudavalli Ramabrahmam under the Sarathi Films banner. It stars Akkineni Nageswara Rao and S. Varalakshmi.

items.title: Bāhubali: The Epic
items.overview: When a mysterious child is found by a tribal couple near a roaring waterfall, they raise him as their own. As he grows, Sivudu is drawn to the world beyond the cliffs, where he discovers the ancient kingdom of Mahishmati, ruled by a cruel tyrant, haunted by rebellion, and bound to his past. What begins as a quest for love soon unravels a legacy of betrayal, sacrifice, and a forgotten prince.

cast.name: Prabhas
cast.role: Mahendra Bahubali / Amarendra Bahubali / Maharaja Veerendra Vikramadeva

overviews.fr: Sauvé des eaux à la naissance, Shiva développe en grandissant une force prodigieuse et un courage exceptionnel. Parvenu à l’âge adulte, il décide d’escalader la vertigineuse cascade qui domine son village. Il découvre au sommet un monde inconnu et fait la rencontre d’Avanthika, une guerrière rebelle qui lutte pour libérer la reine Devasena, prisonnière de l’empire de Mahishmati. Fasciné par la détermination de la jeune femme, Shiva décide de lui venir en aide, ignorant encore ses propres liens avec ce royaume – dont il est en réalité le prince héritier : Baahubali.
overviews.pt: Um guerreiro lendário surge de origens humildes para desafiar forças poderosas que ameaçam sua terra natal, à medida que antigas profecias e laços familiares moldam sua jornada.
overviews.de: Als ein Stammespaar in der Nähe eines tosenden Wasserfalls ein mysteriöses Kind findet, ziehen sie es wie ihr eigenes auf. Während er heranwächst, fühlt sich Sivudu unwiderstehlich zu der Welt jenseits der Klippen hingezogen. Dort entdeckt er das uralte Königreich Mahishmati, das von einem grausamen Tyrannen beherrscht, von Rebellion geplagt und eng mit seiner eigenen Vergangenheit verwoben ist. Was als eine Suche nach der Liebe beginnt, entpuppt sich bald als ein Vermächtnis aus Verrat, Opferbereitschaft und der Geschichte eines vergessenen Prinzen.
overviews.es: Cuando una pareja tribal encuentra a un niño misterioso cerca de una estruendosa cascada, lo crían como si fuera suyo. A medida que crece, Sivudu se siente atraído por el mundo más allá de los acantilados, donde descubre el antiguo reino de Mahishmati, gobernado por un tirano cruel, asolado por la rebelión y ligado a su propio pasado. Lo que comienza como una búsqueda por amor, pronto desentraña un legado de traición, sacrificio y un príncipe olvidado.
overviews.bg: Когато тайнствено дете е намерено от племенна двойка близо до ревящ водопад, те го отглеждат като свое дете. Докато расте, Сивуду е привлечен от света отвъд скалите, където открива древното кралство Махишмати, управлявано от жесток тиранин, преследвано от бунт и свързано с миналото му. Това, което започва като търсене на любов, скоро разплита наследство от предателство, жертви и забравен принц.
overviews.ru: Раненая женщина с младенцем на руках убегает от вооружённых солдат. Понимая, что долго не протянет, она возносит последнюю молитву богам и просит спасти жизнь ребёнка, а сама погружается на дно реки, держа младенца в вытянутой руке над водой. На следующий день его находят местные жители и решают усыновить. Спустя годы мальчик превращается в крепкого и рослого парня Шивуду, наделённого невероятной силой. Однажды он находит маску и решает во что бы то ни стало разыскать её владельца, не подозревая, что она принадлежит прекрасной воительнице Авантике, которая всем своим кланом пытается вызволить королеву Девасену из плена тирана Бхаллаладевы.

items.title: N.T.R: Kathanayakudu
items.overview: Based on the journey of the legendary Telugu actor, filmmaker and ex-Chief Minister Late Taraka Rama Rao Nandamuri.

items.title: Devara: Part 1
items.overview: Devara, a fearless man from a coastal region, embarks on a perilous journey into the treacherous world of the sea to safeguard the lives of his people. Unbeknownst to him, his brother Bhaira is plotting a conspiracy against him. As events unfold, Devara passes on his legacy to his mild-mannered and timid son, Varada.

overviews.fr: Devara, un homme intrépide originaire d'une région côtière, se lance dans un périlleux voyage dans le monde dangereux de la mer afin de protéger la vie de son peuple. À son insu, son frère Bhaira complote contre lui. Au fil des événements, Devara transmet son héritage à son fils Varada, un homme doux et timide.
overviews.de: Devara kämpft als unerschrockener Retter für die Benachteiligten und gleichzeitig als erbarmungsloser Schrecken gegen seine Widersacher. An der Küste und auf hoher See stellt er sich den Herausforderungen und wird zur Hoffnung für jene, die seiner Hilfe brauchen, während er seine Gegner in Angst und Schrecken versetzt.
overviews.pt: Na distante e esquecida região costeira da Índia, não existe nenhum sentido de humanidade entre as pessoas. Os vilões não temem a morte nem a vingança de Deus, mas Devera muda esse cenário no seu estilo único e inimitável.
overviews.ko: 전사의 후예들이 밀수꾼으로 전락하고 말았다. 마을의 명예를 회복하려는 리더의 핏빛 대장정을 그린 영화.
overviews.es: Un intrépido hombre llamado Devara se aventura en el traicionero mundo del mar para proteger la vida de su pueblo. Ignorante de la conspiración de su hermano Bhaira, acaba transmitiendo su legado a su apacible hijo Varada.
overviews.ru: Эпическая экшн-сага, действие которой разворачивается в прибрежных землях и в которой рассказывается о захватывающих, эмоционально заряженных происшествиях на Красном море...
overviews.pl: Devara, nieustraszony człowiek z nadmorskiego regionu, wyrusza w niebezpieczną podróż do zdradzieckiego świata morskiego, aby chronić życie swojego ludu. Nie wie, że jego brat Bhaira knuje spisek przeciwko niemu. W miarę rozwoju wydarzeń Devara przekazuje swoje dziedzictwo swojemu łagodnemu i nieśmiałemu synowi, Varadzie.

items.title: Plan B
items.overview: The story begins with the demise of a lawyer named Vishwanath and travels through multiple twists, suspense and turns without leaving a single clue for the police to find.

items.title: Laila
items.overview: Sonu Model, a renowned beautician from the old city, is forced to disguise himself as Laila, leading to a series of comedic, romantic, and action-packed events. Chaos ensues in this hilarious laugh riot

overviews.ru: Сону Модел, знаменитый косметолог из старого города, вынужден притвориться Лайлой, что становится причиной череды забавных, романтических и динамичных происшествий. Всё оборачивается настоящим хаосом в этой уморительной комедии.
overviews.pt: Sonu Model, um renomado cabeleireiro da cidade velha, é forçado a se disfarçar de Laila, o que leva a uma série de eventos cômicos, românticos e repletos de ação. O caos se instala nesta hilariante comédia.

items.title: Lucky Baskhar
items.overview: A middle-class bank clerk who longs to trade stability for adventure gets more than he bargained for when he unexpectedly becomes a wealthy man.

overviews.de: Obgleich Baskhar ein gewöhnlicher Mann ist, verbirgt sich hinter seiner Person dennoch eine fesselnde Reise über seine großen Triumphe.
overviews.pt: Um caixa de banco sem dinheiro embarca em um esquema de investimento arriscado e logo é atraído para o mundo obscuro da lavagem de dinheiro.
overviews.it: Un cassiere di banca a corto di soldi si imbarca in un rischioso piano di investimento e ben presto si ritrova coinvolto nel torbido mondo del riciclaggio di denaro.
overviews.ko: 돈에 쪼들리는 은행 직원이 위험한 투자 계획에 뛰어들었다가 곧 돈세탁이라는 어두운 세계에 휘말리게 된다.
overviews.ru: Бедный кассир, работающий в банке, ввязывается в рискованную инвестиционную схему и вскоре оказывается втянутым в мрачный мир отмывания денег.
overviews.tr: Monoton hayatından sıkılıp maceraya atılmak isteyen orta sınıf bir banka memuru, beklenmedik bir şekilde zengin olunca hiç hesaba katmadığı durumlarla karşılaşır.

items.title: Pushpa 2 - The Rule
items.overview: As his smuggling empire grows, a brazen Pushpa longs for power and respect on his vengeful journey, while facing old rivals and new.

overviews.de: Pushpa und Bhanwar Singh setzen ihre Rivalität in diesem epischen Abschluss des zweiteiligen Action-Dramas fort.
overviews.fr: Pushpa Raj est devenu une figure puissante et redoutée dans le commerce illégal de bois de santal rouge. Après avoir affronté des ennemis dans le premier volet, ce second chapitre met en lumière sa montée en puissance et sa rivalité intense avec l’officier de police Bhanwar Singh.
overviews.ru: Это вторая часть серии фильмов «Пушпа» и продолжение фильма 2021 года «Пушпа: Восхождение». Столкновение продолжается: Пушпа и Бханвар Сингх продолжают свое соперничество в этом эпическом завершении двухсерийной боевика.
overviews.es: Pushpa y Bhanwar Singh continúan su rivalidad en esta épica conclusión de la serie de dos partes.
overviews.ko: 그의 밀수 제국이 확장됨에 따라, 대담한 푸슈파는 복수의 여정에서 권력과 존경을 갈망하며, 옛 라이벌들과 새로운 적들을 마주하게 된다.
overviews.pt: À medida que seu império de contrabando cresce, o audacioso Pushpa anseia por poder e respeito em sua jornada vingativa, enquanto enfrenta antigos rivais e novos.
overviews.tr: Kaçakçılık imparatorluğu büyüdükçe küstahlaşan Puşpa, güç ve saygı peşinde koştuğu intikam yolculuğunda eski ve yeni düşmanlarıyla karşı karşıya gelir.

items.title: The Rajasaab
items.overview: Seeking his lost grandfather, a young man enters a haunted mansion and awakens a family curse powerful enough to upend both his life and reality.

overviews.de: Als ein junger Erbe den Thron besteigt, verbindet er seine königliche Herkunft mit einem ausgeprägten Hang zur Rebellion. Unter dem Namen Raja Saab übernimmt er die Führung und beginnt, bestehende Strukturen aufzubrechen, indem er eigene Regeln etabliert und neue Wege einschlägt.
overviews.ru: За Гангаммой, страдающей болезнью Альцгеймера, ухаживает ее внук РаджаСааб. Она почти все забывает, но цепляется за воспоминания о своем муже Канакараджу, экзорцисте, который, как считается, живет в изгнании. Поиски деда приводят РаджаСааба в Хайдарабад, где он влюбляется в набожную монахиню Бесси, а другая женщина, внучка вора, по имени Бхайрави, предлагает помощь в поисках Канакараджу. В конце концов поиски приводят группу в печально известный особняк с привидениями. Они обнаруживают, что Канакараджу - не жертва, а виновник всех их бед...
overviews.fr: Un jeune héritier embrasse à la fois son héritage royal et son esprit rebelle tandis qu'il accède au pouvoir, établissant des règles sans précédent durant son règne en tant que Raja Saab.

items.title: Tenali Ramakrishna BA.BL
items.overview: Tenali Ramakrishna is a small-time lawyer who makes his living via compromises between warring parties. He is looking for a big case that could turn his life.

items.title: Nachindi Girl Friendu
items.overview: Raja Ram aka Raja, a confident youngster who has just completed his graduation, heads out with a friend to join a finance course. On the way, he falls in love with Sandhya aka Sandy, a software developer who heads an IT firm. From that instance, his life takes several mysterious turns in a few hours.

items.title: Kalki 2898-AD
items.overview: In the year 2898 AD, around 6000 years after Kurukshetra war, Ashwatthama gears up for his final battle of redemption at the sign of hope in a dystopian world and Bhairava, a wisecracking and self-interested bounty hunter, tired of the perilous life becomes the hurdle in the process.

overviews.ar: عندما يسيطر الظلام على العالم ، ستنشأ قوة جديدة.
overviews.pt: Bhairava, cansado dos confins opressivos de sua terra natal e da vida perigosa de um caçador de recompensas, anseia por uma existência mais confortável no Complexo. Sua busca por uma nova vida o envolve inadvertidamente com um grupo de rebeldes dedicados a libertar a humanidade das garras de forças malévolas.
overviews.fr: En l'an 2898 de notre ère, environ 6000 ans après la guerre de Kurukshetra, Ashwatthama se prépare à son ultime bataille de rédemption, signe d'espoir dans un monde dystopique, et Bhairava, un chasseur de primes malicieux et intéressé, fatigué d'une vie périlleuse, devient l'obstacle de ce processus.
overviews.ja: 故郷の抑圧的な束縛と賞金稼ぎの危険な生活にうんざりしたバイラヴァは、コンプレックスでのより快適な生活に憧れている。新しい生活を求めるバイラヴァは、人類を悪意ある勢力の支配から解放することに専心する反乱軍の集団と、うっかり絡み合うことになる。
overviews.ru: 2898 год. На Земле правит император, которому противостоят повстанцы из тайного города Шамбала. Правая рука императора, коммандер Манас, работает над проектом по поиску формулы бессмертия императора. С помощью повстанцев из проекта удается сбежать необычной девушке, которую за огромное вознаграждение пытаются поймать наемники императора. Тем временем древнее пророчество, гласящее, что явится спаситель и избавит человечество от страданий, начинает сбываться.
overviews.tr: Bhairava, memleketinin baskıcı sınırlarından ve bir ödül avcısının tehlikeli hayatından bıkmış, Kompleks'te daha rahat bir yaşam özlemi çekmektedir. Yeni bir hayat arayışı, onu istemeden insanlığı kötü niyetli güçlerin pençesinden kurtarmaya adanmış bir grup isyancıyla bir araya getirir.
overviews.ko: 인류가 시작되기 이전, 태고의 어느 시기, 전쟁에서 패배한 아쉬와타마는 다음 인류에서 구원을 얻게 되기 전까지 죽지 못하는 저주를 받는다. 그로부터 6,000년이 지나 전쟁과 살육으로 점철된 현생 인류가 도달하게 된 디스토피아. 하나의 정부가 모든 군대와 자원을 통제하며, 돈이 있는 사람들만이 콤플렉스라 불리는 대규모 단지에서 상대적으로 평안한 삶을 영위할 수 있다. 콤플렉스에서는 프로젝트 K라는, 가임기 여성들을 대상으로 하는 비밀 실험이 진행되고 있다.
overviews.es: La historia se desarrolla en un futuro lejano, en el año 2898 AD. El mundo está en caos y decadencia, y una sociedad llamada 'The Complex', formada por la élite y los ricos, tiene acceso a todos los recursos restantes del planeta. Aquellos que no pudieron comprar su entrada en el complejo viven en extensos barrios marginales, donde la comida y el agua son muy escasas.  En este mundo, llega un rayo de esperanza, donde la gente cree que Dios vendrá a rescatarlos en forma de un avatar. Ashwathama, un guerrero inmortal de la era del Mahabharata, busca redención protegiendo al niño que reside en el vientre de Sumathi.  Al mismo tiempo, The Complex intenta capturar a Sumathi, colocando una recompensa por su cabeza. Aquí es donde entra Bhairava, un cazarrecompensas. Él intenta luchar contra Ashwathama y reclamar la recompensa para sí mismo.
overviews.de: Kalki 2898 AD ist ein visuelles und erzählerisches Meisterwerk, das den Zuschauer von der ersten bis zur letzten Minute in seinen Bann zieht. Regisseur Nag Ashwin schafft es, die Essenz hinduistischer Mythologie in ein spektakuläres Science-Fiction-Setting zu übertragen, das sowohl künstlerisch als auch emotional überzeugt. Die Welt des Jahres 2898 ist atemberaubend gestaltet: Der Kontrast zwischen der sterilen Brutalität des „Complex“ und den lebendigen Überresten der Rebellion in Shambhala zeigt die Liebe zum Detail in der Produktion.

items.title: PSV Garuda Vega
items.overview: A dedicated NIA officer is torn between love for his family and his duty. On the brink of sacrificing his career for his family, he stumbles upon a plot with international ramifications. Does he stick to his decision to quit or will the call of duty prove too strong for him?

items.title: 1st Rank Raju
items.overview: Raju, an engineering student is obsessed with academics until he is thrown into the real world where he stumbles and tries to learn some very important life lessons.

items.title: Rarandoi Veduka Chudham
items.overview: A happy-go-lucky boy falls in love with a village belle and after initially facing rejection from her, realises that he has a lot to do to win her love.

items.title: Karmakhya
items.overview: A mysterious visit to a grieving family pulls a young woman into a terrifying world of secrets, black magic, and haunting illusions. As disturbing events begin to blur the line between reality and nightmare, Kaamakhya finds herself trapped in a chilling chain of events rooted in a dark past that refuses to stay buried.

items.title: Godari Gattupaina
items.overview: In the picturesque Godavari villages, a kind-hearted auto driver and a spirited college girl fall in love, but their bond is tested by her father's expectations and unforeseen challenges.

items.title: Vareva
items.overview: Rishi (Gautam) is a happy going engineering student who falls in love with Sandhya (Shambavi), his classmate. Sandhya’s father (Devan) is a rich business man but he accepts their love. Gautam takes the heroine to Vizag to take the blessings of his mom. Suddently, he’ll be attacked in Vizag by some goons and everyone feels that it is Devan who did it. But it is by a Vizag goon Bhupathi (Ashish Vidyarthi), as Gautham accidentally kills his brother while saving one of his friends. Bhupati’s batch chase him and how Gautham solves the problem is all about the movie.

items.title: Maa Babu
items.overview: Dr Anand, a respectable doctor, gives away his son to Ratna Devi, a widow. Soon, he marries a nurse and troubles between them ensue.

items.title: F2: Fun and Frustration
items.overview: After Venky, Varun also gets married thinking he can keep the wife in control but both of them gets frustrated with the marital life which generates fun.

overviews.pt: Depois de Venky, Varun também se casa pensando que pode manter a esposa no controle, mas os dois ficam frustrados com a vida conjugal que gera diversão.
overviews.ru: Венки и Варуну повезло со «вторыми половинами». Ребята встретили настоящих красавиц, которые приходиться еще и сестрами. Невольно придется общаться всем четверым. Однако в большом семействе крайне сложно угадать настроение того, с кем требуется регулярно контактировать. Хани и Харика сходны в одном, кроме сногсшибательной красоты. Они склонны проявлять командные черты характера, что совершенно не дает мужчинам возможностей диктовать условия. Как долго представители сильной части населения планеты способны мириться с подобной несправедливостью? Не решаться ли они на своеобразный бунт? И какую угрозу таит выяснение отношения для противоборствующих сторон? Как избавиться от женской диктатуры, не приводя при этом к разрыву романтических связей? Выдержат ли узы проверку на прочность?

items.title: Salaar: Part 1 - Ceasefire
items.overview: Set in the fictional dystopian city-state of Khansaar, the film follows the friendship between Deva, a tribesman, and Varadha, the prince of Khansaar. When a coup d'état is planned by his father's ministers and his relatives, Varadha enlists Deva's help to become Khansaar's undisputed ruler.

overviews.pt: Um líder de gangue tenta cumprir uma promessa feita ao seu amigo moribundo e enfrenta outras gangues criminosas.
overviews.de: Ein Bandenführer versucht ein Versprechen einzulösen, das er seinem sterbenden Freund gegeben hat. Dafür muss er es jedoch mit anderen kriminellen Banden aufnehmen.
overviews.fr: Après l'énorme succès mondial de KGF1 & KGF2. Le réalisateur Prashanth Neel nous ramène de nouveau dans son monde avec SALAAR.  Un chef de gang tente de tenir une promesse faite à son ami mourant et s'en prend aux autres gangs criminels…
overviews.ru: Главный герой, чья судьба переплетается с темной стороной подпольного мира. Оказывается перед сложным выбором, из-за обещания данного другу в детстве. Это обещание становится его священным долгом и толчком к действию. Герой, смело бросает вызов преступным группировкам. Его поступки не только нарушают хрупкое равновесие в подпольном мире, но и вызывают цепную реакцию событий, которые влияют на всю преступную среду.
overviews.ko: 치열한 권력 다툼이 벌어지고 있는 왕국. 한때 친구였지만 이제는 적이 된 두 사람의 아슬아슬한 동맹에 그 운명이 달려있다. 권력과 살육, 배신에 관한 대서사극.
overviews.it: Nella città di Khansaar, Raja Mannar progetta di nominare suo figlio, Vardharaja Mannar, suo successore, ma i ministri e i consiglieri di Raja Mannar pianificano un colpo di stato assumendo eserciti dalla Russia e dalla Serbia per attaccare e uccidere Vardha e Raja. Vardha, insieme a suo fratello e ad alcuni uomini fidati, riescono a fuggire da Khansaar. Vardha va dal suo migliore amico d'infanzia, Deva, che viene a conoscenza della sua difficile situazione e decide di renderlo l'indiscusso successore di Khansaar.

items.title: Vanaveera
items.overview: A descendant of the Vanara clan is pushed into conflict when a modern-day Ravana seizes his only bike for an election rally. What starts as a petty injustice soon erupts into a fierce fight for self-respect and dignity.

overviews.fr: Un descendant du clan Vanara se retrouve plongé dans un conflit lorsque Ravana des temps modernes lui confisque sa seule moto pour un meeting électoral. Ce qui commence comme une simple injustice dégénère rapidement en une lutte acharnée pour le respect de soi et la dignité.

items.title: Sundari
items.overview: A village girl is married to a software employee who is head over heels with her beauty. Life takes an unexpected turn when her husband loses his job and she is forced to take a few steps that she has to go through an emotional turmoil.

items.title: Pallaburusu
items.overview: A 70 year old widower asks his son to buy him a toothbrush for his toothache. When the son fails to do this simple errand, their already strained father-son relationship becomes comically worse through a series of escalating events.

items.title: Dacoit
items.overview: Betrayed by his better half, a man is convicted for a crime he didn't commit. Once free, he hunts her down in pursuit of vengeance, as their stories intertwine with a series of robberies.

items.title: Madhura Wines
items.overview: Ajay is an alcoholic, struggling to get over the break-up with his girlfriend in college, Madhura. He then meets Kiseema, who falls for him after knowing his past. Meanwhile  Anand, who owns Madhura Wines too is devastated that Ajay is ruining his life with his drinking problem. What happens to the brewing relationship between Ajay and Anjali now?

items.title: RDX Love
items.overview: Alivelu is a village belle who works as a campaigner for government welfare schemes to reach the Chief Minister of the state. How Siddu the son of a biggie, meets her and will she actually solve the long lasting problem of her village?

items.title: Rojulu Maraayi
items.overview: Venu enlightens the villagers against Sagarayya, a greedy landlord who grabs barren lands of the village, and reports to the Collector. Sagarayya creates a rift between Venu and his father which affects his sister's marriage. Venu starts living separately with his wife Radha. The film shows the revolt of the villagers against their oppressors

items.title: Vantalakka
items.overview: After Murali's untimely death, Varalakshmi restarts her life and finds herself at odds with Vishnu, her imperious boss. Can this hate ever turn into love?

items.title: Maa Annayya
items.overview: Gangadhar, an elder brother to four girls, dedicates his life to raising them and getting them married. However, his perspective changes when he learns about their ambitions.

items.title: Pallakilo Pellikuturu
items.overview: A modern and independent Sasirekha meets Abhiram, a man of traditions. Forced into marriage, can they find their happily ever after?

items.title: Subhasya Seeghram
items.overview: Krishna Priya wants to fulfil her mother’s wish to get her elder sister married. What happens when she meets Radha Govind, a business tycoon who’s against marriage?

items.title: Ennenno Janmala Bandham
items.overview: Yash loves his daughter, Khushi, but fails to express himself. Vedaswini adores the kid, which makes Yash envy her. Can Khushi bring these lonely hearts closer?

items.title: Oka Chinna Family Story
items.overview: Mahesh and his mother embark on an adventurous journey filled with hilarious situations as they try to make quick money to repay a huge loan.

seasonList.name: Season 1
seasonList.overview: Mahesh is an unemployed youth who, along with his mother, must earn 25 lakh rupees to repay a loan taken by his dead father. As they struggle to make money, Mahesh realises the unsaid truth behind his dad's invaluable sacrifice.

items.overview: Rajeshwari, a compassionate cook aspiring to keep her mother’s hotel thriving, challenges Rudra, an elite chef when he decides to usurp her hotel to grow his premium food business.

items.overview: Geetha decides to not get married for fear of her parents being neglected. Govind falls in love with her and promises to let her parents stay with them, without realising its consequences.

items.title: Radhaku Neevera Pranam
items.overview: Radhika, a sketch artist, and Karthik, a no-nonsense police officer, are pulled together by fate when a tragic incident changes their lives.

items.title: Sixth Sense
items.overview: A first-of-its- kind show involving the unique senses of humans and explore their thinking abilities with minutely orchestrated nuances between the host and participating celebrities. Sight, hearing, taste, smell and touch are the typically recognized human senses,

items.title: Yeda Loyallo Indradhanasu
items.overview: On her journey to become an outstanding teacher, Amulya finds herself in the crosshairs of her corrupt boss. How will she surpass the challenges thrown her way?

items.overview: Amrutham is a popular sitcom in Telugu. It was produced by Just Yellow Media. It was the longest running and most popular sitcom in Telugu.

seasonList.overview: Amrutham (Telugu: అమృతం, lit., Amrita) is a popular sitcom in Telugu. It was produced by Just Yellow Media and is the longest running and most popular sitcom in Telugu.

items.title: Jagamae Sangeetham
items.overview: Set in Vaikuntapuram, a sacred temple town nestled between the banks of the Godavari and the neon lights of pop stardom, a disciplined heir to a musical throne and a fame-weary singer strike a forbidden chord. To protect a century of heritage, they must navigate a landscape of family secrets, masked identities, and the heavy price of finding their own voices.

overviews.ko: 젊은 카르나틱 신동이 할아버지의 명성과 가족의 생존이라는 무거운 짐을 짊어진다. 경제적 압박이 점점 커지고, 삼촌 티아가라주를 통해 오랫동안 묻혀 있던 가문의 갈등이 다시 수면 위로 드러나면서 발루는 지금까지 지켜야 한다고 믿었던 모든 가치에 의문을 품게 된다. 그러던 중, 예상치 못한 협업을 시작하게 된 발루는 전통과 가문을 완전히 새로운 시선으로 바라보게 된다.

items.title: Vikram On Duty
items.overview: Battling his past and personal demons, a disgraced but brilliant supercop will stop at nothing to solve crimes and earn back the uniform that defined him.

seasonList.name: Season 1
seasonList.overview: Battling his past and personal demons, a disgraced but brilliant supercop will stop at nothing to solve crimes and earn back the uniform that defined him.

items.title: Loser
items.overview: Loser is a 2020 ZEE5 Telugu Original series starring Priyadarshi, Annie, Kalpika, and Shashank. Set between 1980 and 2000, this sports drama narrates the story of 3 players struggling to succeed in their game, each during a different time frame, and their lives eventually colliding with each other.

items.title: Ishmart Jodi
items.overview: Twelve popular celebrity couples participate in a series of fun and entertaining challenges in order to win the title of 'Ishmart Jodi'.

items.title: Mass Jathara
items.overview: Get ready for a comedy carnival! Talented teams perform hilarious skits, competing to deliver the biggest laughs. With Jani Master, Navdeep, and Bindu Madhavi judging the fun, expect witty banter, energetic acts, and nonstop entertainment.

items.title: Arabia Kadali
items.overview: A fictional suspense drama series that revolves around a group of fishermen from rival villages who inadvertently trespass into international waters and find themselves imprisoned in a foreign jail.

overviews.ko: 안드라프라데시의 한 외딴 마을. 어부들은 가혹한 환경 탓에 어획기마다 생계를 위해 구자라트로 향한다. 그러나 올해는 예상치 못한 해류에 휩쓸려 국경을 넘게 되고, 파키스탄에 억울하게 구금되고 만다. 생존을 위해 몸부림치는 그들은 뜻밖에 우정을 쌓고 새로운 유대감을 형성하며, 치명적인 적들과 맞서 싸운다. 과연 그들은 살아남아 고향으로 돌아올 수 있을까?

items.title: Super Subbu
items.overview: An unlucky teacher is assigned to teach sex ed in a hostile village. Can he balance this secret while chasing his dreams and saving his relationship?

overviews.pt: O azarado Subbu é designado para ensinar educação sexual em uma comunidade nada acolhedora. E precisa fazer o trabalho dar certo sem despertar a ira do pai conservador.
overviews.ko: 잘 풀리는 일이 없는 수부. 하필이면 성교육을 맡게 되어, 적대적인 마을에서 보수적인 아버지의 노여움을 사지 않고 어떻게든 이 일을 해내야만 한다.
overviews.tr: Talihsiz Subbu, huysuz köylülere cinsel eğitim dersi vermekle görevlendirilir. Genç adam, muhafazakâr babasının öfkesinden kaçınırken başarılı olmanın bir yolunu bulmak zorundadır.
overviews.pl: Pechowiec Subbu ma prowadzić zajęcia z edukacji seksualnej we wrogiej wiosce. Czy uda mu się osiągnąć sukces zawodowy i uniknąć gniewu konserwatywnego ojca?
overviews.fr: Subbu, un prof malchanceux dont la vie bascule lorsqu'il devient secrètement professeur d'éducation sexuelle pour adultes dans un village rural de Makhipur, conciliant les attentes strictes de son père tout en poursuivant ses rêves et sa romance.
overviews.es: Subbu, un joven con una racha de mala suerte, su vida cambia cuando se convierte secretamente en profesor de educación sexual para adultos en un pueblo rural de Makhipur, equilibrando las estrictas expectativas de su padre mientras persigue sus sueños y su romance.

seasonList.name: Season 1
seasonList.overview: When unlucky Subbu is assigned to teach sex ed in a hostile village, he must find a way to succeed while avoiding his conservative father's wrath.

items.overview: A young bride's life is in peril when she marries into a mysterious household. Despite her dark past, she is determined to uncover the secrets of her new family.

overviews.ar: تنهار شركة رامبو الناشئة حتى تدخل سوكانيا حبيبته السابقة كمستثمرة تتحكم فى مصيره. بين صراعات المكتب وندوب الماضي ومشاعر لم تطفاً، يتقاطع الكبرياء مع الحب في كوميديا رومانسية عن فرص لا تأتي إلا مرة أخرى.

items.title: Dhootha
items.overview: Journalist Sagar's life turns thrilling as he unravels dark secrets behind newspaper clippings predicting tragedies. He becomes a murder suspect, racing against time to clear his name and solve the enigma and faces dangerous twists. Suspense builds in this roller-coaster ride.

overviews.ru: В этом сверхъестественном триллере жизнь журналиста Сагара переворачивается с ног на голову, когда газеты предсказывают леденящие душу инциденты, которые разворачиваются в его жизни.
overviews.pt: A vida do jornalista Sagar fica emocionante à medida que ele desvenda segredos obscuros por trás de recortes de jornais que preveem tragédias. Ele se torna suspeito de assassinato, e corre contra o tempo para limpar seu nome e resolver o enigma, enfrentando reviravoltas perigosas. O suspense aumenta no desenrolar vertiginoso da série.
overviews.ko: 비극을 예언하는 신문 기사 조각에 숨겨진 어두운 비밀이 밝혀지면서 기자인 사가르의 삶이 흔들린다. 살인 용의자로 지목된 사가르는 누명을 벗고 수수께끼를 풀기 위해 사투를 벌이면서 위험한 반전을 맞는다. 숨 막히는 짜릿한 여정이 시작되고 긴장감이 쌓여 간다.
overviews.fr: La vie du journaliste Sagar prend un tournant haletant quand il dévoile de sombres secrets derrière des coupures de journaux prédisant des tragédies. Il devient le suspect d'un meurtre et tente alors de prouver son innocence et de résoudre l'énigme, mais il est confronté à des rebondissements dangereux. Le suspense monte et on est pris de vertige dans ce thriller oppressant.

seasonList.overview: Journalist Sagar's life turns thrilling as he unravels dark secrets behind newspaper clippings predicting tragedies. He becomes a murder suspect, racing against time to clear his name and solve the enigma and faces dangerous twists. Suspense builds in this roller-coaster ride.

overviews.pt: Ambientada em uma cidade portuária fictícia entre as décadas de 1980 e 1990, a série acompanha Naidu, um poderoso chefão do crime que constrói um império baseado no contrabando e na influência política. Quando rivais ameaçam derrubar seu domínio, o maior desafio surge dentro da própria família: sua filha Bharathi, líder de uma ONG, confronta o legado de violência do pai.
overviews.hi: बंदरगाह शहर इसाकापट्नम में, नायडू एक बाहरी व्यक्ति से उठकर उस इलाके का सबसे खौफ़नाक इंसान बन जाता है - वह बंदरगाह की राजनीति, जुर्म और बेहिसाब बेरहमी के दम पर अपना साम्राज्य खड़ा करता है। जैसे-जैसे राजनीतिक दुश्मनी, गैर-कानूनी व्यापार और बदलती वफादारियाँ एक ज़बरदस्त ड्रामा खड़ा करती हैं, नायडू अपनी जगह बनाए रखने के लिए किसी भी हद तक जाने को तैयार है। पर उसकी बेटी भारती अब उसे चुनौती देने लगती है।

items.overview: Sanjay Vishwanath is an acclaimed professional handgunner in his 40s with a major stake in fame and wealth. When he comes across a woman named Maddy in her 20s, their dynamic poses many issues that they must come to terms with.

overviews.de: Sanjay Vishwanath ist ein gefeierter Profi-Pistolenschütze in den Vierzigern, dem Ruhm und Reichtum sehr am Herzen liegen. Als er einer Frau namens Maddy in den Zwanzigern begegnet, wirft ihre Beziehung viele Probleme auf, mit denen sie sich auseinandersetzen müssen.

items.overview: 4 Major characters running for the Money facing more challenges by forgetting the fact that it's not the decision of money to reach human.

items.title: Jana Nayagan
items.overview: A clash of ideologies. One stands for the people, the other feeds on control. Their paths collided once before. Years later, a child’s silent fear ignites the past, drawing a former police officer into a battle far bigger than personal revenge.

overviews.de: Ein wahrer Anführer strebt nicht nach Macht, sondern setzt sich für die Menschen ein.
overviews.pt: Um choque de ideologias. Uma defende o povo, a outra alimenta-se do controlo. Os seus caminhos já se cruzaram antes. Anos mais tarde, o medo silencioso de uma criança reacende o passado, arrastando um ex-polícia para uma batalha muito maior do que uma simples vingança pessoal.
overviews.ru: Бывший полицейский Ветри Кондан живёт ради приёмной дочери. Он учит её не бояться и давать отпор. Но в стране появляется таинственный враг под именем Гиммлер. Он сеет хаос и хочет устроить революцию. Ветри снова берётся за оружие. Ему нужно защитить и дочь, и родину. А враг оказывается старым знакомым, который жаждет мести.
overviews.fr: Un choc idéologique. L’un se bat pour le peuple, l’autre se nourrit de contrôle. Leurs chemins se sont déjà croisés. Des années plus tard, la peur silencieuse d’un enfant réveille le passé, entraînant un ancien officier de police dans une bataille qui dépasse de loin la simple vengeance.

items.title: Karuppu
items.overview: In a world where justice falters, guardian deity Vettai Karuppu takes the guise of a lawyer to battle a corrupt legal system preying on the powerless.

overviews.de: In einer Welt, in der die Gerechtigkeit ins Wanken gerät, erwacht ein mächtiger Beschützer. In diesem actiongeladenen Fantasy-Spektakel erhebt sich ein Übermensch in einer verdorbenen Welt, um die Dinge wieder ins Lot zu bringen.
overviews.pt: Num mundo onde a justiça falha, a divindade guardiã Vettai Karuppu assume a forma de um advogado para combater um sistema jurídico corrupto que se aproveita dos mais vulneráveis.
overviews.ru: Смертельно больная девочка нуждается в срочной пересадке печени. Её отчаявшийся отец приезжает из Кералы в Ченнаи с золотом, чтобы оплатить операцию, но становится жертвой ограбления, а дело погружается в коррумпированную судебную систему, где бесконечно откладывается. В молитве к деревенскому божеству-хранителю семья получает неожиданный ответ — Каруппа спускается на землю в человеческом облике адвоката. Теперь тому, кто вершил правосудие на небесах, предстоит сразиться с продажной системой, циничным прокурором и безжалостными воротилами, наживающимися на чужом горе. Сможет ли бог в человеческом обличье изменить судебную систему или даже высшие силы бессильны перед земной коррупцией?

items.title: Blast
items.overview: A seemingly ordinary family must unleash their hidden martial arts skills when they clash with a ruthless criminal gang tied to corruption and violence.

overviews.es: Una familia aparentemente común debe desplegar sus habilidades ocultas en artes marciales al enfrentarse a una despiadada banda criminal vinculada a la corrupción y la violencia.
overviews.ru: Обычная семья: Раджарам, его жена Нилавени и дочь Нила, владеющая навыками карате, оказывается втянутой в смертельно опасную игру с безжалостным преступным синдикатом. Спокойная жизнь рушится, когда они невольно сталкиваются с коррупционным заговором, связанным с незаконной добычей полезных ископаемых. Теперь, чтобы выжить, героям приходится использовать свои боевые навыки и сражаться против целой армии наёмников, не зная ни истинных масштабов угрозы, ни даже личности главного врага. Сумеет ли сплочённая семья защитить друг друга и остановить преступные планы, которые грозят уничтожить целый регион?
overviews.it: Una famiglia apparentemente comune deve sfoderare le proprie abilità nascoste nelle arti marziali quando si scontra con una spietata banda criminale legata a corruzione e violenza.

items.title: Modha Rathri
items.overview: Two strangers are brought together at an unusual wedding where, in one night, too many surprises unfold and several lies are told, spiraling into chaos that changes everything.

items.title: Raagu Kethu
items.overview: Raagu Kethu is a 2025 Indian Tamil-language film written and directed by Durai Balasundaram. The film stars P. Samuthirakani, Archana Kanthan, and Sandhya Sree in the lead roles. It is produced by Santhi Balasundaram under the banner of Thamizharasan Theaters.

items.title: Idhayam Murali
items.overview: A young man navigates the complexities of unrequited love, finding that even as years pass and life takes unexpected turns, certain emotions remain deeply embedded in his heart.

items.title: Kaattu Puli
items.overview: Sanjay's family goes on a picnic into a forest. They lose their way in the jungle and encounter a gang involved in stealing organs. Sanjay fights against the gang to save his family.

items.title: Once More
items.overview: Raghu, a man caught up with a deep hold of grief comes across Anjali, who is spinning everything in her capacity to win him over. The love you gave away always comes back they say. In one way or other. Sometimes from a different human. This is a story of love coming back into the life of someone who doesn’t want to take it. A tale of second chances.. happy healing and bitter sweet closures.

overviews.de: Raghu, ein Mann, der tief in Trauer versunken ist, begegnet Anjali, die alles in ihrer Macht Stehende tut, um sein Herz zu gewinnen. Man sagt, die Liebe, die man verschenkt hat, kehrt immer zurück. Auf die eine oder andere Weise. Manchmal durch einen anderen Menschen. Dies ist die Geschichte einer Liebe, die in das Leben eines Menschen zurückkehrt, der sie eigentlich nicht annehmen will. Eine Geschichte von zweiten Chancen, glücklicher Heilung und bittersüßen Abschlüssen.

items.title: Kara
items.overview: A thief tries to go straight, but when predatory banks trap his father in debt, he returns to crime — with a determined cop closing in on his trail.

overviews.de: Ein Mann, der von Gewalt und dem Kampf ums Überleben geprägt ist, gerät erneut in eine Gefahr, der er nicht entkommen kann. Während feindliche Kräfte immer näher rücken, fordern frühere Entscheidungen ihren Tribut. Mit jeder Konfrontation steigen die Kosten für das Überleben. Das Überleben hängt von Entschlossenheit, Instinkt und der Bereitschaft ab, sich den Konsequenzen direkt zu stellen
overviews.es: Un ladrón trata de enderezar su vida, hasta que las deudas de su padre con prestamistas abusivos lo arrastran a robar de nuevo..., pese a tener a un resuelto policía tras su rastro.
overviews.sv: En yrkestjuv försöker gå rätt till väga, men när giriga banker leder hans far in i skulder återgår han till brottsligheten – med en beslutsam polis i hans spår.
overviews.pt: Um ladrão tenta endireitar a vida, mas quando bancos predatórios prendem o seu pai numa armadilha de dívidas, ele volta ao crime com um polícia determinado a aproximar-se cada vez mais dele.
overviews.ru: В 1991 году в деревне Раманатхапурам на фоне кризиса из-за войны в Заливе бывший вор Кара (Дхануш) пытается начать честную жизнь: продать наследственную землю и открыть столовую с женой Селли. Но его мечтам мешают коррумпированный банкир и жестокий полицейский, загоняющие фермеров в долги и отбирающие земли. Чтобы спасти семью и односельчан, Кара вынужден вернуться к преступному прошлому и замыслить дерзкое ограбление. Сможет ли он восстановить справедливость или прошлое навсегда затянет его в пропасть?

items.title: Vilaiyaattu Pasange
items.overview: The simplicity of chaotic life struggles, the beautiful relationship between a man and his son, a man and the apple of his eye, and a funny yet comical bonding among three loyal friends who have each other for love, support and brotherhood.

items.title: Double Occupancy
items.overview: Rajini transforms between woman by day and man by night, hiding this gender swap from partners creating tangled complications.

overviews.fr: Après une naissance miraculeuse accordée par une divinité transgenre, un enfant grandit en étant deux personnes distinctes partageant un même corps : une femme le jour et un homme la nuit, chacun avec ses propres souvenirs, rêves et désirs. Devenus adultes, tous deux tombent amoureux de partenaires différents et commencent à construire des vies séparées à Chennai. Mais lorsqu’un généticien découvre leur existence et cherche à l’exploiter, ils doivent se battre pour protéger leur secret, leurs proches et leur droit à coexister.
overviews.ru: По воле божественного случая одно тело с рождения разделено между двумя совершенно разными душами. Днём это тело принадлежит женщине Раджини (Решма Венкатеш) — амбициозной ученой, а ночью — мужчине Раджини (Сантош), который работает барменом. Они никогда не встречались и не могут поговорить, но вынуждены сосуществовать, оставляя друг другу лишь «следы» своего пребывания в общей жизни. Проблемы начинаются, когда каждая из половин влюбляется в разных людей. Теперь двум незнакомцам, живущим в одном теле, предстоит столкнуться с хаосом, который приносят их чувства. Смогут ли они найти способ быть счастливыми и защитить свой секрет от генетика?

items.title: Gatta Kusthi 2
items.overview: Picks up after the first film, with Veera and Keerthi balancing parenthood and Keerthi's wrestling career, featuring a role reversal where Veera takes on more domestic responsibilities.

overviews.es: Un amo de casa cría a su hija para apoyar la carrera de su esposa, pero deberá remontar las críticas ajenas, los escollos de la paternidad y los de su propio matrimonio.

items.title: Youth
items.overview: Youth follows Praveen, a 15-year-old boy who enters adolescence determined to find true love before school ends. As he goes through multiple relationships and heartbreaks, he slowly begins to understand what love truly means. Along the way, the experiences shape his growth, maturity, and outlook on life.

overviews.pt: Youth acompanha Praveen, um garoto de 15 anos que entra na adolescência determinado a encontrar o amor verdadeiro antes do fim das aulas. Conforme ele passa por vários relacionamentos e decepções amorosas, ele lentamente começa a entender o que o amor realmente significa. Ao longo do caminho, as experiências moldam seu crescimento, maturidade e visão de vida.

items.title: Anaagarigam
items.overview: Story of a newly married professor who suffers his whole life for having an affair with his student.

items.title: Jailer 2
items.overview: Following the events of "Jailer",  former ruthless police officer Muthuvel Pandian must come face-to-face with an even larger threat.

items.title: Leo
items.overview: Parthiban, a cafe owner, lives with his family in Himachal Pradesh. Things take an absurd turn for him when he gets in the way of a drug cartel.

overviews.fr: Le protagoniste et sa famille vivent dans une petite ville vallonnée où ils tiennent un café et mènent une vie paisible. La ville entière est ébranlée lorsqu'une bande de voleurs entre dans la ville, ce qui entraîne la mort mystérieuse de nombreuses personnes. La façon dont cette situation affecte la famille du protagoniste et ce qu'il fait pour y remédier constituent le coeur de l'histoire.
overviews.ar: يعيش ليو داس رفقة عائلته في بلدة صغيرة حيث تُدير العائلة مقهى بسيط، وسريعًا تنقلب الأمور في حياة العائلة وليو حينما تُهاجم عصابة البلدة وتقتل العديد من المواطنين.
overviews.pt: Leo é um filme de suspense de ação em língua tâmil indiano dirigido por Lokesh Kanagaraj e produzido por S. S. Lalit Kumar e Jagadish Palanisamy. É estrelado por Vijay como personagem titular, ao lado de Sanjay Dutt, Trisha, Arjun, Gautham Vasudev Menon, Mysskin, Mansoor Ali Khan e Priya Anand.
overviews.es: Un hombre de modales apacibles se convierte en un héroe local a través de un acto de violencia, pero trae consecuencias relacionadas con la conexión con un mundo peligroso, uno que sacudirá su vida cuidadosamente construida hasta la médula.
overviews.ru: Партибан живёт в небольшом городке вместе с женой и двумя детьми. Он управляет кафе и периодически занимается спасением диких животных. Однажды вечером в его заведение заходят опасные бандиты, которые после заказного убийства пытаются добыть денег и скрыться. Понимая, что его вместе с маленькой дочкой как свидетелей в живых не оставят, Партибан вступает в бой с преступниками, и, завладев оружием, убивает их всех. Ситуация получает широкую огласку в прессе, а лицо героя появляется на первых страницах газет. Вскоре данная информация доходит до главаря криминальной группировки, который узнаёт в Партибане своего погибшего сына, которого звали Лео Дас.

items.title: Madras to Pondicherry
items.overview: Mala, a modern college girl witnesses the murder committed by Sudhagar and hops into a bus bound for Pondicherry. Sudhagar follows and tries to kill her on the journey.

items.title: Anbe Diana
items.overview: Set in Perambur, a local Telugu youth falls for an Anglo-Indian girl, sparking a chaotic and humorous clash of cultures between their families.

items.title: Uriyadi 2
items.overview: A young man struggles for justice for the victims who are affected by the chemical plant leakage which lead to many deaths in the village.

items.title: Nala Damayanthi
items.overview: A village cook Ramji goes to Australia to become a chef at a multi-millionaire Indian's home. Unfortunately, the millionaire dies of indigestion the day Ramji arrives, leaving him jobless with an expired visa. Desperate to stay and earn, he starts working illegally as a cook, but to stay on, he needs to get legal. A solution comes up when Damayanthi, a free-spirited biker, agrees to marry the docile cook for a price.

items.title: Gandhi Talks
items.overview: A silent black comedy, about the monetary needs of a character & how it impacts the others. A young, unemployed graduate Mahadev’s struggle to land a job through any means possible and crosses paths with a businessman and petty thief. A subject wherein silence speaks much louder than words. Although a work of fiction by the writer, all the characters in the film are sketched out to seem very real and relatable ensuring an enriching journey as well a laugh riot as the cat and mouse guffaws amongst them unfold. Gandhi Talks aims at telling a story by switching off the device of dialogue, which is not only scary but also interesting and challenging.

items.title: Savaale Samaali
items.overview: Two employees try to get their debt-ridden TV channel to the top position by manufacturing a fake reality show that involves uniting lovers who face opposition at home.

items.title: Master
items.overview: An alcoholic professor is sent to a juvenile school, where he clashes with a gangster, who uses the children of the school for criminal activities.

overviews.ru: Невероятно крутой, но страдающий алкоголизмом преподаватель из университета попадает в исправительную колонию для несовершеннолетних преступников, где ему придется побороться за умы и сердца с безжалостным преступником, который использует молодежь для прикрытия своих преступлений.
overviews.pt: Um professor alcoólatra é encaminhado para uma escola juvenil, onde enfrenta um gangster, que usa as crianças da escola para atividades criminosas.
overviews.fr: JD est un professeur faisant face à des problèmes de dépendance d’alcool. Il est obligé à quitter l'université pour aller enseigner dans un centre de détention juvénile pendant quelques mois. Alors que JD se la coule douce, il réalise que les jeunes de ce centre sont en fait exploités par Bhavani, un gangster cruel.

items.title: Kaadhal Parisu
items.overview: Sisters Malini and Chitra are heirs to a huge fortune. Chitra is in for a shock when she introduces her boyfriend to Malini and the latter accuses him of raping her years ago.

A quirky 29-year-old named Sathya embarks on an unexpected journey of laughter, unlikely friendships, and self-discovery. Through hilarious misadventures and chance encounters, he slowly sees life's bigger picture - its surprises, joys, and second chances.

overviews.es: Sathya está en crisis ahora que su cumpleaños número 30 se aproxima y él se siente un fracaso. Pero tras enamorarse de una mujer ambiciosa, descubre su propósito en la vida.
overviews.pt: É um drama romântico indiano dirigido por Rathna Kumar. A trama acompanha Sathya, um jovem de 29 anos em crise de identidade que se apaixona por Viji, uma mulher de espírito livre e focada na carreira. O relacionamento força o casal a confrontar a diferença entre a fantasia do amor e a realidade da vida.

items.title: Thaai Kizhavi
items.overview: An elderly and feared moneylender from a village near Madurai falls seriously ill, prompting her estranged sons and extended family to reunite after years of separation. As tensions rise inside the household, hidden motives, family conflicts, and expectations over her wealth turn her uncertain condition into the center of a chaotic family drama.

items.title: Thozha
items.overview: Premji, Vijay Vasanth, and Nithin Sathya are close friends. Ajay Raj, who is out to avenge the killing of his younger sister by her boyfriend, also joins these friends. In this situation, a rowdy's daughter, Jennifer, loves Ajay, but he does not reciprocate. He has to first kill the person who cheated his sister and took her life. When it is known that it is Nitin Sathya who is the culprit, Ajay picks up an 'aruval' and rushes to confront Nitin. In the meantime, Nitin hires a mercenary paying him Rs 5 lakes to kill Ajay. The friends are divided and the outcome of the clashes between them forms the climax.

items.title: Jailer
items.overview: Muthuvel Pandian, a retired, stern yet compassionate jailer lives a peaceful life with his family, but trouble knocks his door when his cop son’s tryst with an antique mafia gang goes awry and forces Muthu to step back into a dark world he had voluntarily took a break from.

overviews.fr: Muthuvel Pandian est un geôlier strict mais empathique qui apprend qu'un gang tente de faire évader son chef de la prison. Il se met alors en tête de les arrêter.
overviews.tr: Muthuvel Pandian, ailesiyle birlikte huzurlu bir hayat yaşamaktadır, ancak ailesinin hayatına aniden giren istenmeyen partiler, onu uzun süredir geride bıraktığı bir yola dönmeye zorlar.
overviews.ko: 무투벨 판디안은 가족과 함께 평화로운 삶을 살지만, 갑작스러운 불청객의 침입으로 인해 오랫동안 떠나있던 길로 돌아서야만 합니다.
overviews.es: Muthuvel Pandian vive una vida pacífica con su familia, pero una repentina irrupción de personas no deseadas en la vida de su familia lo obliga a tomar un camino que había dejado atrás hace mucho tiempo.
overviews.pt: Muthuvel Pandian, um carcereiro aposentado, severo mas compassivo, vive uma vida pacífica com sua família, mas os problemas batem à porta quando num encontro com a antiga gangue de mafiosos e o seu filho policia dá errado, força Muthu a fazer uma pausa e voltar ao mundo sombrio do qual saiu voluntariamente.

items.title: Parimala and Co
items.overview: A dark comedy centered around a chaotic family whose tangled relationships and unpredictable situations lead to emotionally charged and absurd moments, blending humor with underlying tension and drama.

overviews.es: Una comedia negra centrada en una familia caótica cuyas relaciones enredadas y situaciones impredecibles conducen a momentos absurdos y cargados de emociones, que mezclan humor con tensión y drama subyacentes.

items.title: Invoking Justice
items.overview: In Southern India, family disputes are settled by Jamaats—all male bodies which apply Islamic Sharia law to cases without allowing women to be present, even to defend themselves. Recognizing this fundamental inequity, a group of women in 2004 established a women’s Jamaat, which soon became a network of 12,000 members spread over 12 districts. Despite enormous resistance, they have been able to settle more than 8,000 cases to date, ranging from divorce to wife beating to brutal murders and more. Deepa Dhanraj follows several cases, shining a light on how the women’s Jamaat has acquired power through both communal education and the leaders’ persistent, tenacious and compassionate investigation of the crimes. In astonishing scenes we watch the Jamaat meetings, where women often shout over each other about the most difficult facets of their personal lives.

items.title: Ninaithen Vandhai
items.overview: Ezhil is devastated after his wife Indhumathi’s death. A simple village girl, Sudarvizhi, steps in to be his children's caretaker. But can Sudarvizhi fill the void in Ezhil and his children’s hearts?

items.title: Kanaa
items.overview: Anbarasi, an innocent village girl, dreams of making a name for herself in the field of sports but faces numerous obstacles. Will she manage to tackle the hurdles and fulfil her dream?

items.title: Resort
items.overview: A debt-ridden room service boy rises to challenge a ruthless kitchen at a luxurious beachside haven.

overviews.ar: يجد عامل خدمة غرف لم يكمل دراسته نفسه داخل مطبخ فاخر في منتجع شاطئي راق، حيث تبدأ رحلته لإثبات نفسه وسط ضغط لا يرحم.

seasonList.name: Season 1
seasonList.overview: A 12th-fail room service boy rises to challenge a ruthless kitchen at a luxurious beachside haven.

items.title: Neeya Naana
items.overview: A talk show where two polarised groups of society are given the platform to share their views and see a different perspective on socially-relevant topics.

seasonList.name: Season 23
seasonList.overview: A talk show where two polarised groups of society are given the platform to share their views and see a different perspective on socially-relevant topics.

items.title: Cooku with Comali
items.overview: Cooku with Comali, also known by the acronym CWC, is an Indian Tamil-language comedy-based cooking competition show aired on Star Vijay and streams on Disney+ Hotstar where the contestants are paired each week with comedians (comalis) who are amateur cooks. The first season premiered on 16 November 2019 and ended on 23 February 2020. The second season was premiered on 14 November 2020 and ended on 14 April 2021. The third season was premiered on 22 January 2022 and ended on 24 July 2022. The contestants along with their comalis are challenged every week and judged by Chef Damu and Chef Venkatesh Bhat.

seasonList.name: Season 1
seasonList.overview: Cooku with Comali (season 1) is the first season of the Tamil reality cooking TV show Cooku with Comali, that was aired first on 16 November 2020. This season was hosted by Rakshan and Aranthangi Nisha.

seasonList.name: Season 2
seasonList.overview: Cooku with Comali (season 2) is the second season of the Tamil reality cooking TV show Cooku with Comali, that was aired first on 14 November 2020. This season was hosted by Rakshan.

seasonList.overview: Cooku with Comali (Season 3) is the third season of the Tamil reality cooking TV show Cooku with Comali, that was launched on 22 January 2022. This season is hosted by Rakshan, and judged by Chef Damodharan and Chef Venkatesh Bhat.

seasonList.name: Season 4
seasonList.overview: Cooku with Comali (Season 4) is the fourth season of the Tamil reality cooking TV show Cooku with Comali, which will launch on 28th January 2023 on Star Vijay. Over four years, Cooku with Comali has rolled out three seasons and Rakshan has officially been appointed as the host for the fourth time. C

seasonList.overview: Cooku with Comali (Season 5) is the fifth season of the Tamil reality cooking tv show.

seasonList.overview: When cooking chaos meets comic charm! Comalis pair up with stars for a rib-tickling contest, judged by chefs Damu, Koushik Shankar and Madhampatty Rangaraj.

seasonList.name: Double Trouble
seasonList.overview: Double trouble, endless laughter! Comalis pair up with your favourite celebrity couples for a hilarious culinary showdown.

items.title: Sandakozhi
items.overview: Mahalakshmi and Vikram resent each other, but when their siblings fall in love, they unite to bring the two together despite all odds.

items.title: Heart Beat
items.overview: RK Multispeciality Hospital is a beacon of hope and healing. Its doctors are resilient even when they have to deal with medical and personal challenges.

seasonList.name: Season 2
seasonList.overview: Reena has become Reena 2.0, Radhi has embraced a new full-time role, and new interns have joined RK Multispeciality to bring fresh rhythm and beats to the hospital.

seasonList.name: Season 3
seasonList.overview: A year after Reena's car accident, RK Multispeciality Hospitals has begun a new chapter, with new doctors and new management but old wounds.

items.title: Vidhya No. 1
items.overview: Vedavalli, a successful entrepreneur, believes in the importance of education. But her opinion changes when Vidhya, an illiterate woman with immense native wisdom, becomes her daughter-in-law.

items.title: Super Singer Junior
items.overview: Super Singer Junior is a reality TV show since February 2007 hosted by Vijay TV. It is a singing talent hunt for the children of age group 6–15. This is the junior version of the Super Singer show.

seasonList.name: Season 10
seasonList.overview: The hunt for the next Super Singer begins with an exciting panel of judges! Extraordinary young talents compete against each other for the coveted title.

seasonList.name: Season 11
seasonList.overview: Twenty rising stars take centre stage on Super Singer. With daring rounds and legendary mentors, every note tells a story. Who will claim the coveted crown?

items.title: Peranbu
items.overview: Karthik regrets marrying Vanathi, a simple girl chosen by his mother, Raja Rajeshwari. But, Raja Rajeshwari is determined to prove that Vanathi is a good woman and the right choice for her son.

items.title: LBW: Love Beyond Wicket
items.overview: A washed-up PT teacher, a legendary coach and a generation of misfit students come together to save a legacy.

seasonList.name: Season 1
seasonList.overview: A washed-up PT teacher, a legendary coach and a generation of misfit students come together to save a legacy.

items.title: Meenakshi Ponnunga
items.overview: Meenakshi, abandoned by her husband, braves all stigma and hardships to bring up her three children. One of her daughters, Sakthi, vows to become an IAS officer and restore her mother's lost pride.

items.title: Adhu idhu yedhu
